title: Coherent synchrotron radiation extraction from a bent beam pipe
summary: Coherent synchrotron radiation generated in a bending magnet can propagate far downstream and heat the beam pipe. We investigate a beam-free side outlet that diverts part of this radiation into a separate guide. We use a paraxial equation to calculate radiation generation in the bend and its division between the two guides. Modal and finite-difference solutions are used in the bend, and quadratic finite elements on a changing transverse mesh in the branching region. We check the paraxial approximation against full-wave solutions at selected frequencies. Separately, we calculate radiation attenuation in a conducting pipe without an outlet using complex modes that satisfy impedance boundary conditions. For this example, independently damped perfectly conducting modes underestimate the high-frequency transmitted power. For a $70\times25$ mm rectangular chamber with a $30^\circ$ bend of radius 2.2 m and Gaussian bunches of rms length $10\,μ$m, the selected outlet diverts about 53\% of the total outgoing radiation power into the beam-free channel.

AI.tldr: 研究在弯曲磁铁处设置无束侧出口，将部分相干同步辐射分流到独立波导，并用傍轴与全波/复模方法评估分流与管道衰减。
AI.motivation: 相干同步辐射会在弯曲磁铁中产生并向下游传播，可能加热束流管；因此需要研究无束侧出口，将部分辐射引离主束流管道。
AI.method: 采用傍轴方程计算辐射在弯段中的产生及在两个波导间的分配；弯段使用模态解和有限差分解，分支区使用变化横向网格上的二次有限元；在选定频率上将傍轴近似与全波解对比。另对无出口导体管道，用满足阻抗边界条件的复模计算辐射衰减。
AI.result: 在70×25 mm矩形腔、30°弯转、半径2.2 m、高斯束团均方根长度10 μm的算例中，所选出口将约53%的总出射辐射功率分流到无束通道；无出口导体管道算例中，独立衰减的理想导体模会低估高频透射功率。
AI.conclusion: 无束侧出口可分流相当大比例的相干同步辐射功率，示例中约为53%；高频传输衰减建模需考虑满足阻抗边界条件的复模，而不能仅依赖独立衰减的理想导体模。摘要未提供实验验证或更广泛参数扫描结果。

title: Fock-space relativistic coupled-cluster study of systematic shifts and fine-structure constant sensitivity in {\rm Cf$^{17+}$}, {\rm Cm$^{15+}$} and {\rm Bk$^{16+}$} highly charged ions
summary: Highly charged ions (HCIs) are among the most promising candidates proposed for the development of next-generation optical clocks and the precision tests of fundamental physics. In this work, we investigate the clock-relevant properties of $\rm Cf^{17+}$, $\rm Cm^{15+}$ and $\rm Bk^{16+}$ HCIs using Fock-space relativistic coupled-cluster (FSRCC) theory. The corrections from Breit interaction, QED effects and perturbative triples are incorporated to improve the accuracy of results further. We compute excitation energies, transition amplitudes, lifetimes, hyperfine structure constants, electric quadrupole moments, and electric dipole polarizabilities for low-lying states of these ions. These properties are further used to characterize important clock transitions and estimate key systematic frequency shifts. Our calculations reveal that the proposed clock transitions exhibit strongly suppressed systematic frequency shifts. We also compute the sensitivity coefficients, $q$, and enhancement factors, $K_α$, for the proposed clock transition as a probe to variation in the fine-structure constant, $α$. Our calculations predict exceptionally large $K_α$ of $-55.3$ and $57.5$ for $5f_{5/2} \rightarrow 6p_{1/2}$ transition in $\rm Cf^{17+}$ and $6p_{1/2} \rightarrow 5f_{5/2}$ transition in $\rm Bk^{16+}$, respectively. These giant $K_α$s place the proposed transitions among the most sensitive optical probes for the laboratory searches for $α$ variation. Further, a comparative analysis of proposed transitions in $\rm Cm^{15+}$ and $\rm Bk^{16+}$ shows that, $5f_{5/2} \rightarrow 5f_{7/2}$ transition possess smaller systematic shifts and is therefore attractive for precision frequency metrology, whereas $6p_{1/2} \rightarrow 5f_{5/2}$ transition exhibit significantly enhanced sensitivity to $α$ variation.

AI.tldr: 本文用Fock空间相对论耦合簇理论计算Cf^{17+}、Cm^{15+}和Bk^{16+}高电荷离子的钟相关原子性质，评估候选钟跃迁的系统频移，并筛选对精细结构常数α变化高度敏感的跃迁。
AI.motivation: 高电荷离子是下一代光学钟和基础物理精密检验的重要候选体系，因此需要系统研究其钟跃迁性质、系统频移以及探测α变化的灵敏度。
AI.method: 采用Fock空间相对论耦合簇（FSRCC）理论，并纳入Breit相互作用、QED效应和微扰三体修正；计算低 lying 态的激发能、跃迁振幅、寿命、超精细结构常数、电四极矩和电偶极极化率，进而表征钟跃迁、估计关键系统频移，并计算灵敏度系数q和增强因子K_α。
AI.result: 计算表明候选钟跃迁的系统频移受到强烈抑制；Cf^{17+}的5f_{5/2}→6p_{1/2}跃迁K_α为-55.3，Bk^{16+}的6p_{1/2}→5f_{5/2}跃迁K_α为57.5，属于对α变化最敏感的光学探针之一。Cm^{15+}与Bk^{16+}的比较显示，5f_{5/2}→5f_{7/2}跃迁系统偏移较小，更适合精密频率计量；6p_{1/2}→5f_{5/2}跃迁对α变化灵敏度显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 这些高电荷离子跃迁在光学钟和实验室搜寻α变化方面具有前景；不同跃迁在低系统频移与高α灵敏度之间存在取舍。摘要未提供实验验证或绝对钟性能指标。

title: Accurate ab initio calculations of the ground state properties of singly charged alkali metal hydrides
summary: In this article, we investigate the ground state electronic properties of singly charged alkali metal hydrides using the single-reference coupled-cluster method with single and double excitations (CCSD), together with perturbative triple excitations (CCSD(T)). A large relativistic core-valence quintuple-zeta basis set has been employed. The calculated spectroscopic constants and molecular properties are compared with existing data in the literature. Further, the relevant vibrational parameters are determined by solving the vibrational Schrödinger equation utilizing potential energy curves and permanent dipole moment curves. Thereafter, spontaneous and black-body radiation induced transition rates are calculated to obtain the lifetimes of the vibrational states.

AI.tldr: 本文用CCSD和CCSD(T)方法结合大型相对论核-价五zeta基组，研究单电荷碱金属氢化物的基态电子性质，并基于势能曲线与偶极矩曲线求解振动薛定谔方程，计算振动参数及自发和黑体辐射诱导跃迁速率以得到振动态寿命。
AI.motivation: 研究单电荷碱金属氢化物的基态电子性质，并将计算得到的光谱常数和分子性质与文献数据进行比较；进一步确定相关振动参数并获取振动态寿命。
AI.method: 采用单参考耦合簇单双激发方法CCSD及微扰三激发CCSD(T)，使用大型相对论核-价五zeta基组；利用势能曲线和永久偶极矩曲线求解振动薛定谔方程，并计算自发辐射和黑体辐射诱导的跃迁速率。
AI.result: 计算了光谱常数和分子性质并与现有文献数据比较；确定了相关振动参数，并通过跃迁速率计算得到振动态寿命。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明该工作可提供单电荷碱金属氢化物的电子结构、振动参数及振动态寿命信息，但未明确给出全文结论或具体数值结论。

title: Macroscopic Nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer Mediated by Coherent Magnons
summary: Phonon-mediated nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer (RET) in metal deuterides is severely constrained by inertial rest-mass dilution, lattice fracture limits, and thermal nuclear spin cancellation. Extending the generalized nuclear Dicke model to Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR) magnons eliminates mass dilution via hyperfine-amplified M1 coupling while unlocking relativistic Dirac M2 coupling via Overhauser spin polarization. We derive a Suhl-clamped FMR scaling law predicting 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) and 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) breakup neutrons, 19.9 MeV alpha particles, and reconciled sub-keV fusion anomalies.

AI.tldr: 该文针对金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受惯性静质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消限制的问题，提出将广义核Dicke模型推广到铁磁共振（FMR）磁振子，并通过超精细增强的M1耦合与Overhauser自旋极化引入相对论性Dirac M2耦合，推导Suhl钳制FMR标度律并给出高能产物预测。
AI.motivation: 金属氘化物中的声子介导核RET受到惯性静质量稀释、晶格断裂极限及热核自旋抵消的严重约束，作者希望借助FMR磁振子克服这些限制，并建立可预测核产物的理论标度关系。
AI.method: 将广义核Dicke模型扩展至FMR磁振子；利用超精细增强的M1耦合消除质量稀释，并通过Overhauser自旋极化解锁相对论性Dirac M2耦合；据此推导Suhl钳制的FMR标度律。
AI.result: 该标度律预测Pd-106对应14.2 MeV、Ni-58对应11.4 MeV的破裂中子，19.9 MeV的α粒子，并调和了亚keV聚变异常。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明FMR磁振子方案在理论上可缓解金属氘化物核RET的关键限制，并给出特征核产物能量；但未提供实验验证、误差分析或模型参数细节，相关预测仍属理论结果。

title: Predictive electronic feedback control for narrow-linewidth lasers
summary: Narrow-linewidth lasers are essential for various key atom-laser interaction processes and optical setups in quantum coherent control, quantum precision measurement, and quantum information science. The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) technique is the standard method for the frequency-stabilization of narrow-linewidth lasers, but the inherent time delay in its feedback loop inevitably induces excessive phase noise, commonly known as servo bumps. Previous solutions primarily rely on additional optical components outside the electronic feedback control loop. Here, we propose and implement a generic method based on the Smith predictor to address the time-delay issue entirely within the electronic part of the PDH feedback control loop. We systematically demonstrate its capability to suppress phase noise and reduce servo bumps by adding only a single Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) controller to the loop. This class of methods is demonstrated to be conceptually concise with minimal hardware overhead, effective in practice, and holds potential for a wide variety of future applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对PDH稳频反馈环路中固有时间延迟所导致的过量相位噪声和伺服凸起问题，提出并实现了一种基于Smith预测器的通用补偿方法；该方法完全在电子反馈控制环内工作，仅需增加一个FPGA控制器，并展示出抑制相位噪声、降低伺服凸起的能力，具有概念简洁、硬件开销小和推广应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 窄线宽激光器在量子相干控制、量子精密测量和量子信息科学中的关键原子-激光相互作用过程和光学装置中十分重要；PDH技术是窄线宽激光器稳频的标准方法，但反馈环路的固有时间延迟会不可避免地引入过量相位噪声，即伺服凸起。此前方案主要依赖电子反馈控制环之外的额外光学组件，本文希望在电子控制环内通用地解决时延问题。
AI.method: 提出并实现基于Smith预测器的通用方法，在PDH反馈控制环的电子部分补偿时间延迟；实现上仅向环路加入单个Field-Programmable Gate Array（FPGA）控制器。摘要未提供Smith预测器的具体结构、PDH环路参数、实验平台及对比方案等细节。
AI.result: 系统性展示该方法能够抑制相位噪声并降低伺服凸起，且仅需增加单个FPGA控制器，体现出最小硬件开销和实际有效性。摘要未提供相位噪声抑制量、伺服凸起降低幅度、激光线宽或长期稳定度等定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的优势是概念简洁、硬件开销小、实际有效，并有望在未来多种应用中推广；摘要未给出长期鲁棒性、不同系统适用性及具体应用验证数据。

title: Realization of a Superleak in a Quantum Gas
summary: Ultracold quantum gases offer a controllable and microscopically accessible platform for understanding and engineering superfluidity. Yet, realizing a superleak that selectively transports the superfluid while suppressing normal flow has remained elusive. Here, we harness an optical superlattice to realize such a superleak through dynamical selectivity. The superfluid undergoes coherent Josephson transport, whereas the normal component exhibits slow, thermodynamically limited response, resulting in a flow-rate contrast of 500(49). Exploiting this contrast, we demonstrate repeated filtering of the normal component and dynamical purification of the superfluid, while sustaining coherent driven oscillations for up to 100 cycles. Our results establish a controllable atomic superleak and open possibilities for manipulating transport and thermodynamics in quantum fluids.

AI.tldr: 该文利用光学超晶格实现具有动力学选择性的原子超漏：超流分量进行相干约瑟夫森输运，正常分量响应缓慢且受热力学限制，从而获得500(49)的流量对比，并演示正常分量重复过滤、超流动态纯化及最长100周期的相干驱动振荡。
AI.motivation: 超冷量子气体为理解和调控超流性提供了可控且微观可及的平台，但实现选择性输运超流、同时抑制正常流动的超漏仍难以实现。
AI.method: 采用光学超晶格构建超漏，通过动力学选择性区分超流与正常分量：超流表现为相干约瑟夫森输运，正常分量表现为缓慢且热力学受限的响应；利用二者流率差异进行重复过滤与动态纯化，并观测驱动振荡。摘要未提供超晶格具体参数、实验系统细节及定量理论模型。
AI.result: 获得500(49)的流量对比；实现正常分量的重复过滤和超流的动态纯化；在最长100个周期内维持相干驱动振荡。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了一个可控的原子超漏，为量子流体中的输运与热力学调控提供了新可能。

title: Lifetime of the singly charged $^{229}$Th nuclear isomer
summary: The nucleus of thorium-229 ($^{229}$Th) has an exceptionally low-energy isomeric state ($^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th). Because its excitation energy is close to the energy levels of valence electrons, the lifetime of $^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th varies substantially depending on its electronic state. Although internal conversion and radiative decay were recently observed, the electronic bridge decay of $^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th, a higher-order decay process through an electronic transition, has not yet been confirmed. A promising candidate to search for this decay channel is singly charged $^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th$^+$ in the electronic ground state. Here we produce $^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th$^+$ by a charge exchange reaction in an ion trap and detect the isomers through measuring the electrons emitted from internal conversion processes. We determined the half-life of $^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th$^+$ to be 0.46(8) s. Our result differs by several orders of magnitude from the half-lives of internal conversion and radiative decay, indirectly suggesting the existence of the electronic bridge decay of $^{229\mathrm{m}}$Th. This will enable the direct observation and further investigation of the electronic bridge process, which will contribute to understanding nuclear-electron interactions and accelerating nuclear deexcitation in the operation of a thorium-based nuclear clock.

AI.tldr: 在离子阱中通过电荷交换反应制备处于电子基态的单电荷 ^229mTh+，测量其内部转换发射电子并确定半衰期为 0.46(8) s；该值与内部转换和辐射衰变半衰期相差数个数量级，间接提示 ^229Th 的电子桥衰变存在。
AI.motivation: ^229Th 具有异常低能量的同质异能态 ^229mTh，其激发能接近价电子能级，寿命强烈依赖电子状态。内部转换和辐射衰变已被观测，但电子桥衰变尚未确认；电子基态单电荷 ^229mTh+ 是搜寻该衰变通道的有希望候选。
AI.method: 利用离子阱中的电荷交换反应产生 ^229mTh+，通过测量内部转换过程发射的电子探测同质异能态，并据此测定 ^229mTh+ 的半衰期。
AI.result: 测得 ^229mTh+ 的半衰期为 0.46(8) s。该结果与内部转换和辐射衰变的半衰期相差数个数量级，间接表明 ^229Th 的电子桥衰变存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究为直接观测和进一步研究电子桥过程提供了可能，有助于理解核-电子相互作用，并促进钍基核钟运行中的核去激发。

title: Influence of nanoparticle shapes in nanofluid film boiling on vertical cylinders: A numerical study
comment: Published in the International Journal of Thermofluids (2024)
summary: This research explores how nanoparticle shapes affect the thermal behavior of nanofluid film boiling along a vertical cylinder, using a Continuous-Species-Transfer method within a Computational Multi-Fluid Dynamics framework. The behavior of nanoparticles in both liquid and vapor phases is modeled, accounting for Brownian motion and thermophoresis. A comprehensive two-dimensional axisymmetric analysis is conducted to investigate the effects of various Al2O3 nanoparticle shapes, including spheres, bricks, blades, cylinders, and platelets, on boiling heat transfer. The results demonstrate that nanoparticle shape has a minimal impact on deposition dynamics but significantly affects kinematic viscosity, particularly for platelet-shaped nanoparticles. Blade-shaped nanoparticles provide substantial enhancement of thermal transport, as indicated by pronounced temperature gradients and increased thermal conductivity. These nanoparticles also improve the Nusselt number, suggesting enhanced boiling heat transfer efficiency. This improvement is particularly significant at higher nanoparticle concentrations, although the relationship is not strictly linear. Future work will explore different nanoparticle materials, boiling scenarios, and experimental validation.

AI.tldr: 该文采用Continuous-Species-Transfer与计算多流体动力学框架，二维轴对称模拟垂直圆柱上Al2O3纳米流体薄膜沸腾，比较球形、砖形、刀片形、圆柱形和片状纳米颗粒的影响。结果表明颗粒形状对沉积动力学影响较小，但显著影响运动黏度；刀片形颗粒强化热输运并提高努塞尔数，在高浓度下更明显但非严格线性。
AI.motivation: 探究不同Al2O3纳米颗粒形状对垂直圆柱表面纳米流体薄膜沸腾热行为的影响，并评估其在强化沸腾换热方面的潜力；摘要未进一步说明更具体的工程应用动机。
AI.method: 在计算多流体动力学框架中采用Continuous-Species-Transfer方法，对液相和气相中的纳米颗粒行为建模，考虑布朗运动与热泳；开展二维轴对称分析，系统比较球形、砖形、刀片形、圆柱形和片状Al2O3纳米颗粒对沸腾换热的影响。
AI.result: 纳米颗粒形状对沉积动力学影响很小，但显著影响运动黏度，片状颗粒尤为明显；刀片形颗粒产生显著温度梯度和更高热导率，明显强化热输运，并提高努塞尔数，表明沸腾换热效率提升；该强化在高纳米颗粒浓度下更显著，但浓度关系并非严格线性。
AI.conclusion: 纳米颗粒形状是调控纳米流体薄膜沸腾换热的重要因素，刀片形Al2O3颗粒在强化热输运和提高努塞尔数方面表现突出；未来将研究其他纳米颗粒材料、不同沸腾场景并开展实验验证。

title: Extended-regularized lattice Boltzmann method
summary: Regularized lattice Boltzmann methods improve numerical stability by projecting the nonequilibrium distribution onto its hydrodynamic second-order Hermite sector and filtering the remaining kinetic modes. We introduce a separate relaxation time for the complete complementary kinetic subspace. The resulting extended-regularized lattice Boltzmann method (E-RLBM) interpolates continuously between the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook and regularized collision operators while retaining a two-rate implementation. A Chapman-Enskog expansion shows that the isothermal Navier-Stokes equations are recovered with kinematic viscosity $ν=c_s^2(τ-Δt/2)$, independently of the kinetic relaxation time $τ_{\rm nh}$, whereas $τ_{\rm nh}$ changes higher-order truncation errors. For linear transverse shear, its first effect is a fourth-derivative term whose coefficient depends on the direction of propagation relative to the lattice. This fourth-order coefficient is affine in $τ_{\rm nh}$. For linear shear on D2Q9 and $τ_{\rm nh}$ between $τ$ and $Δt$, it lies between the corresponding BGK and RLBM values in every propagation direction. Stability maps for the decaying Taylor-Green vortex and flow past a rectangular obstacle show that an appropriate kinetic relaxation substantially enlarges the stable parameter domain. In a Taylor-Green convergence test with consistent initialization, all three operators converge at second order, and their error differences follow the hyperviscous coefficient for diagonal shear waves: the E-RLBM error is about 6% above the BGK error and about 40% below the RLBM error; in a double shear layer at Re = 80000, the E-RLBM follows the RLBM convergence curve. The proposed collision operator therefore provides a low-cost means of controlling nonhydrodynamic modes without introducing a full multiple-relaxation-time basis.

AI.tldr: 提出扩展正则化格子Boltzmann方法（E-RLBM），为完整互补动理学子空间引入独立松弛时间τ_nh，使碰撞算子在BGK与RLBM之间连续插值并保持双速率实现；理论上保持Navier-Stokes黏度不变，同时调节高阶截断误差，数值上可扩大稳定域并以较低成本控制非流体动力学模式。
AI.motivation: 正则化格子Boltzmann方法通过将非平衡分布投影到流体力学二阶Hermite扇区并过滤其余动理学模式来提高数值稳定性；本文旨在不引入完整多松弛时间（MRT）基的情况下，以低成本调节被过滤的非流体动力学模式，并使BGK与RLBM碰撞算子之间能够连续过渡。
AI.method: 为完整互补动理学子空间引入独立松弛时间τ_nh，构造E-RLBM；该格式在BGK与正则化碰撞算子之间连续插值，并保留双速率实现。采用Chapman-Enskog展开分析流体力学极限；针对线性横向剪切分析四阶导数项及其方向依赖性和对τ_nh的仿射关系；在D2Q9上比较τ_nh取τ与Δt之间时与BGK、RLBM的四阶系数；用衰减Taylor-Green涡和绕矩形障碍物流动的稳定性图评估稳定域，并用一致初始化的Taylor-Green收敛测试及Re=80000双剪切层测试比较三种算子的收敛行为。

AI.conclusion: E-RLBM通过一个独立的动理学松弛时间调节非流体动力学模式，在保持二阶流体力学极限和双速率实现的同时扩大稳定域，提供无需完整MRT基的低成本碰撞算子控制手段；摘要未报告计算成本、参数选取准则及三维验证。

title: Stiff source terms inside ADER-DG method
summary: ADER-DG numerical method with the LST-DG predictor, when used to solve hyperbolic equations with stiff source terms, exhibits properties characteristic of IMEX computational schemes. With increasing stiffness, characterized by the parameter $z = ν{Δt}^{n} < 0$, the maximum of the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}$ of the ADER-DG numerical method increases. In the region of strong stiffness $|z| \gg 1$, a linear increase in the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(z) \sim |z|$ occurs. In the region of small source terms $|z| \ll 1$, the results $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(z)$ transform into known results for the problem $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(0)$ without source terms. In the transition region $|z| \sim 1$, a range of insignificant decrease in the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(z)$ is discovered. In the linear case, instability is violated precisely when one of the matrix eigenvalues reaches $λ= -1$, regardless of the phase $θ$ of the numerical solution. A rigorous stability theory of the ADER-DG numerical method for stiff problems for arbitrary degree $N$ of basis polynomials is constructed. The stability condition is simplified to solving a polynomial equation for the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}$. Highly accurate dependencies of the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(N, z)$ of the ADER-DG method on the parameter $z$ are obtained. A rigorous direct proof of the approximation of the ADER-DG method is presented. Approximation orders $p = N+1$ for arbitrary degrees $N$ are rigorously derived. A set of numerical experiments is carried out to apply the ADER-DG method to solving both a linear advection-reaction equation and the system of Euler equations for a two-component reacting medium. The results obtained in these calculations confirm the theoretical results well.

AI.tldr: 该文研究带LST-DG预测子的ADER-DG方法求解含刚性源项的双曲方程时的稳定性与精度，构造任意基多项式次数N的严格稳定性理论，给出CFL_max(N,z)的高精度依赖关系并证明p=N+1阶近似，最后用线性和反应Euler方程数值实验验证理论。
AI.motivation: ADER-DG数值方法配合LST-DG预测子求解含刚性源项的双曲方程时表现出IMEX格式特征；需要严格阐明刚性参数z=νΔt^n<0对Courant数上限CFL_max的影响、建立任意N下的稳定性理论，并给出严格的近似阶证明。
AI.method: 基于线性情形分析稳定性，指出失稳发生于某个矩阵特征值达到λ=-1时且与数值解相位θ无关；将稳定性条件简化为关于Courant数CFL的多项式方程，构造任意次数N基多项式的严格稳定性理论，获得CFL_max(N,z)的高精度依赖关系；给出ADER-DG方法的严格直接近似证明，并开展线性对流-反应方程与双组分反应介质Euler方程组的数值实验。
AI.result: 随着刚性增强（z=νΔt^n<0），CFL_max增大；强刚性区|z|≫1呈线性增长CFL_max(z)∼|z|；小源项区|z|≪1退化为无源项的已知结果CFL_max(0)；过渡区|z|∼1出现CFL_max(z)轻微下降的区间。线性情形下失稳恰在某一矩阵特征值达到λ=-1时发生，与相位θ无关。得到CFL_max(N,z)的高精度依赖关系，并严格导出任意N下的近似阶p=N+1；数值实验与理论结果吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了ADER-DG方法求解含刚性源项问题的严格稳定性理论，覆盖任意基多项式次数N，并将稳定性条件化为求解关于CFL的多项式方程；同时严格证明近似阶p=N+1。理论预测的CFL_max随刚性参数z的变化规律及失稳条件得到数值实验验证，表明该方法在刚性源项情形下具有IMEX类特性。

title: Multigroup Radiation Diffusion with Compton Scattering on a Moving Mesh: Implementation in RICH and Application to Tidal Disruption Events
comment: 27 pages, 16 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ApJS
summary: Compton scattering exchanges energy between radiation and hot gas and changes the spectrum in high-energy astrophysical systems such as tidal disruption events (TDEs). Because it couples all photon energies and can act faster than the hydrodynamic time step, many radiation-hydrodynamics (RHD) simulations omit its spectral redistribution or treat its energy exchange in the gray approximation. We extend the multigroup flux-limited diffusion module of the moving-mesh RHD code RICH to include Compton scattering with the exact thermal Compton kernel. In our semi-implicit scheme for the thermal radiative transfer equation, the temperature dependence of the kernel enters a generalized Fleck factor, and the group Compton operator conserves photon number and satisfies detailed balance. In equilibration tests, the scheme agrees with independent solutions, relaxes without absorption and emission to a Bose-Einstein spectrum, and remains stable for time steps that do not resolve the Compton equilibration timescale. We apply it to a three-dimensional simulation of the disruption of a $0.5\,M_\odot$ star by a $10^6\,M_\odot$ black hole. We find that during the X-ray flash, inverse Compton scattering dominates the coupling between the gas and the radiation near the nozzle shock, where it adds X-ray energy much faster than thermal emission and may affect the dynamics. Outside the X-ray thermalization radii, its instantaneous X-ray production rate during the flash is comparable to or larger than the escaping X-ray luminosity, so it may contribute substantially to the X-ray emission from TDEs.

AI.tldr: 本文将精确热康普顿核加入移动网格辐射流体力学代码 RICH 的多群通量限制扩散模块，采用半隐式格式并以广义 Fleck 因子处理核的温度依赖；测试表明该格式能守恒光子数、满足细致平衡并可在未解析康普顿平衡时标的步长下稳定运行；三维 TDE 模拟显示逆康普顿散射在喷管激波附近主导气体与辐射耦合，并可能显著贡献 TDE 的 X 射线发射。
AI.motivation: 康普顿散射在 TDE 等高能天体系统中交换辐射与热气体能量并改变能谱；它耦合所有光子能量且可能比流体力学时间步更快，但许多辐射流体力学模拟忽略其能谱重分布或仅用灰度近似处理能量交换，因此需要把精确热康普顿核纳入多群辐射输运。
AI.method: 扩展移动网格 RHD 代码 RICH 的多群通量限制扩散模块，加入精确热康普顿核；在热辐射输运方程的半隐式方案中，将核的温度依赖纳入广义 Fleck 因子，并构造守恒光子数且满足细致平衡的分群康普顿算符；开展平衡化测试，并应用于 0.5 太阳质量恒星被 10^6 太阳质量黑洞潮汐瓦解的三维模拟。
AI.result: 平衡化测试中，该方案与独立解一致，在无吸收和发射时弛豫到玻色-爱因斯坦谱，并在不解析康普顿平衡时标的时间步下保持稳定。三维 TDE 模拟中发现：X 射线闪期间，逆康普顿散射在喷管激波附近主导气体与辐射的耦合，其增加 X 射线能量的速度快于热发射并可能影响动力学；在 X 射线热化半径之外，其在闪期间的瞬时 X 射线产生率与逃逸 X 射线光度相当或更大，因此可能对 TDE 的 X 射线发射有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: 精确热康普顿散射可稳定地用于多群 RHD 模拟，并在 TDE 的 X 射线闪动力学与辐射中可能具有重要作用；摘要未给出定量速率、模拟参数细节或观测预测。

title: QuDPy-FDGF: A Python-Based Tool for Computing Ultrafast Nonlinear Optical Responses Using Frequency Domain Green's Functions
summary:
We present QuDPy-FDGF, an open-source Python framework that evaluates Liouville-space pathways as hybrid chains of time propagators and frequency-domain Green's functions. Frequency-resolved intervals are computed directly through shifted linear systems, without time propagation followed by a Fourier transform, while other intervals may remain in the time domain. A model-agnostic block interface separates the physical model from pathway construction, numerical propagation, and detection. The released implementation provides an explicit dense Liouville-space backend for reference calculations and a sector-resolved sparse backend using matrix-free generator actions, Krylov time propagation, and generalized minimal residual (GMRES) resolvent solves. Its observable layer reuses propagated pathway responses to evaluate operator expectation values, action-detected readout interactions, instantaneous jump rates, and integrated mean jump counts.
  The framework is assessed on an analytically solvable open two-level system and on two examples of increasing complexity: the complete third-order rephasing response, with its eight sequences, of a thermally initialized anisotropic Heisenberg (XXZ) spin chain with unequal excitation sectors, and two coupled dissipative anharmonic modes whose spectra depend on the detected observable, with the fifth-order double-quantum response of their closed limit. The calculations reproduce the analytical two-level response, check the matrix-free sparse evaluation against the dense assembly of the generator, and recover the harmonic-limit cancellation of the fifth-order signal when the required three-excitation manifold is retained. QuDPy-FDGF therefore provides a unified framework for pathway- and observable-resolved nonlinear spectroscopy in finite or truncated Hilbert spaces with unitary or Markovian Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad (GKSL) dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了开源 Python 框架 QuDPy-FDGF，用时间传播器与频域格林函数的混合链计算 Liouville 空间路径，并在开放二能级系统、XXZ 自旋链及耦合耗散非谐模上完成基准与示例计算。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性光谱路径计算通常需先做时间传播再做傅里叶变换；作者希望提供一个统一框架，在有限或截断希尔伯特空间中同时支持路径分辨和可观测分辨的光谱计算，并适用于幺正或马尔可夫 GKSL 动力学。
AI.method: QuDPy-FDGF 将 Liouville 空间路径表示为时间传播器与频域格林函数的混合链；频域区间通过移位线性系统直接求解，其他区间可保留在时域。框架采用模型无关的块接口，将物理模型与路径构建、数值传播和探测分离；提供显式稠密 Liouville 空间后端用于参考计算，以及扇区分辨稀疏后端，使用无矩阵生成元作用、Krylov 时间传播和 GMRES 预解求解。其可观测层复用已传播的路径响应来计算算子期望值、作用探测读出相互作用、瞬时跃迁率和积分平均跃迁计数。
AI.result: 框架在可解析求解的开放二能级系统及两个复杂度递增的示例上评估：热初始化的各向异性 Heisenberg（XXZ）自旋链的完整三阶重相位响应及其八个序列（包含不等激发扇区），以及两个耦合耗散非谐模（其光谱依赖被探测可观测，并涉及其闭极限的五阶双量子响应）。计算复现了解析二能级响应，将无矩阵稀疏评估与生成元的稠密组装进行对照校验，并在保留所需三激发流形时复现五阶信号的谐波极限抵消。
AI.conclusion: QuDPy-FDGF 为有限或截断希尔伯特空间中、具有幺正或马尔可夫 GKSL 动力学的路径分辨与可观测分辨非线性光谱提供了一个统一框架；摘要未提供计算规模、性能加速比或更广泛数值精度方面的定量结论。

title: A Priori Estimation of the Non-Linear Compression Potential and Quantification of Autoencoder Non-Linearity in Turbulent Flows
comment: 27 pages, 26 figures, 2 tables. Preprint submitted to Computers & Fluids. Code: https://gitlab.windenergy.dtu.dk/nalpi/how-nonlinear-is-my-flow
summary: Data-driven reduced-order modelling (ROM) of turbulent flows is based on an efficient and physical low-dimensional representation of the flow process. Such a dimension reduction can be achieved using proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) or non-linear autoencoders. Capturing the inherent non-linearities in turbulent flows offers the potential for improved compression rates. This work proposes the local tangent residual (LTR) as an a priori estimate of the potential benefit of non-linear dimension reduction for a given dataset. The LTR is based on the local geometry of the data points, requiring neither prior model training nor the definition of a threshold parameter. For all datasets investigated in this work, namely, two vortex street cases and the turbulent wake flow of a wind turbine, the dominant trends in autoencoder compression performance are reproduced by the proposed LTR. The results are further contextualised through the decoder linearisation error (DLE). The DLE quantifies the non-linearity of the trained decoder by comparing it to a linearised surrogate model, which enables physical interpretability of the non-linearities. Together, a large non-linear compression potential in the turbulent flow, as quantified by the LTR, is corroborated by a large DLE, i.e., a pronounced non-linearity captured in the trained autoencoder. The LTR thus enables practitioners in turbulent flow modelling to determine a priori whether non-linear compression is worthwhile, avoiding the substantial computational cost of autoencoder architecture search and hyperparameter tuning in cases where POD already suffices.

AI.tldr: 论文提出局部切残差（LTR）作为非线性降维收益的先验估计指标，并在多个湍流数据上验证其能复现自编码器压缩性能的主要趋势，同时用解码器线性化误差（DLE）解释非线性程度。
AI.motivation: 湍流的数据驱动降阶建模需要高效且具物理意义的低维表示；POD 或非线性自编码器可实现降维，捕捉湍流非线性有望提高压缩率。但实践中需要事先判断非线性压缩是否值得，以避免在 POD 已足够时仍投入自编码器架构搜索和超参数调优的高昂计算成本。
AI.method: 提出局部切残差（LTR）作为给定数据集上非线性降维潜在收益的先验估计。LTR 基于数据点的局部几何，不需要预先训练模型，也不需要定义阈值参数。论文还引入解码器线性化误差（DLE），通过将训练后的解码器与线性化代理模型比较来量化其非线性，并提升非线性特征的物理可解释性。
AI.result: 在包括两个涡街案例和风力机湍流尾流在内的所有研究数据集上，LTR 复现了自编码器压缩性能的主要趋势。由 LTR 量化出的较大非线性压缩潜力，与较大的 DLE（即训练后自编码器中捕捉到显著非线性）相互印证。摘要未提供具体压缩率、误差数值或定量提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: LTR 可帮助湍流建模实践者事先判断非线性压缩是否值得，从而在 POD 已足够的情况下避免自编码器架构搜索和超参数调优带来的巨大计算成本；DLE 则用于解释和佐证非线性压缩潜力。

title: Bridge change-of-measure for propagator estimation of diffusions
summary: The propagator of one-dimensional diffusions has relevant applications in statistical inference and across many disciplines. Yet it is obtained in closed form only for very few simple models. Here we analyze an importance sampling strategy based on a bridge change of measure to estimate propagators: paths are generated under an auxiliary diffusion whose bridge between the two fixed boundary points is easy to generate, and the target propagator is recovered through a Radon-Nikodym derivative or likelihood ratio correction derived from Girsanov's theorem. This method overcomes the main limitations of the crude Monte Carlo estimator, which relies on binning in state space, introducing bias and becoming inefficient with rare transitions. We apply the method to a range of benchmark processes and show that the bridge-based estimator matches the accuracy of crude Monte Carlo with orders of magnitude fewer sample paths. Finally, we elaborate on discretization schemes for the Radon-Nikodym derivative and on approximations to the best-in-class change of measure, both of which increase the efficiency of the method.

AI.tldr: 论文研究一维扩散传播子的估计问题，提出基于桥式测度变换的重要性采样方法：在易于生成桥路径的辅助扩散下采样，并用Girsanov定理得到的Radon-Nikodym导数/似然比进行修正，从而估计目标传播子。
AI.motivation: 一维扩散的传播子在统计推断和多个学科中有应用，但仅对极少数简单模型有闭式解；粗略蒙特卡洛估计依赖状态空间分箱，会引入偏差，并在稀有转移情形下效率低下。
AI.method: 采用基于桥变化测度的重要性采样策略：路径由辅助扩散生成，该辅助扩散在两个固定边界点之间的桥易于生成；通过Girsanov定理推导的Radon-Nikodym导数或似然比修正恢复目标传播子。论文还讨论Radon-Nikodym导数的离散化方案以及对最优变化测度的近似。
AI.result: 在一系列基准过程上，桥式估计器以少几个数量级的样本路径达到与粗略蒙特卡洛相当的精度；针对Radon-Nikodym导数的离散化方案和最优变化测度近似均提高了方法效率。
AI.conclusion: 桥式重要性采样能够克服粗略蒙特卡洛在分箱偏差和稀有转移效率方面的主要局限，是估计一维扩散传播子的有效方法；摘要未提供具体基准过程、误差指标和理论保证等细节。

title: A novel machine learning framework based on proper orthogonal decomposition for turbine wake flow predictions in natural waterways
summary: We developed a machine learning (ML) surrogate trained on instantaneous large eddy simulation (LES) data filtered using proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) to predict mean flow fields in natural rivers with complex geometries. The surrogate enables efficient prediction of mean flow fields downstream of marine hydrokinetic (MHK) turbine arrays at a fraction of the computational cost of high fidelity simulations, facilitating turbine layout optimization in natural waterways where bathymetry, turbulence, and turbine interactions influence the available energy resource. We demonstrate the capabilities of the model at a real world tidal river site under ebb tide conditions. Complex bed bathymetry and planform geometry generate substantial background turbulence that can obscure turbine wake signatures. POD is employed to extract relevant flow structures, improving the ability of the ML model to learn wake dynamics. First, LES is performed at the tidal site to generate training data. POD is then applied to decompose the instantaneous LES fields into spatial modes. Selected modes are used to train a three dimensional convolutional encoder decoder network to predict time averaged velocity fields. This selective filtering reduces the influence of dominant background fluctuations while preserving information relevant to turbine wakes. At equivalent network size and training cost, the POD filtered surrogate reduces the mean squared error by three orders of magnitude compared with the same network trained on unfiltered LES data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于POD滤波瞬时LES数据的机器学习代理模型，用于以远低于高保真仿真的成本预测复杂天然河流中MHK涡轮阵列下游的平均流场，并在真实潮汐河流落潮工况下验证。
AI.motivation: 高保真LES计算成本高，而天然水道中的复杂地形、湍流和涡轮相互作用会影响可用能量资源；需要高效预测MHK阵列下游平均流场，以支持涡轮布局优化。同时，复杂床面与平面几何产生的强背景湍流会掩盖涡轮尾流特征。
AI.method: 在真实潮汐河流站点落潮条件下开展LES生成训练数据；用POD将瞬时LES流场分解为空间模态，选取部分模态训练三维卷积编码器-解码器网络以预测时间平均速度场；通过选择性滤波降低主导背景脉动的影响，同时保留与涡轮尾流相关的信息，并与未滤波LES数据训练的同规模网络比较。
AI.result: 在等效网络规模和训练成本下，基于POD滤波数据的代理模型相比使用未滤波LES数据的同一网络，将均方误差降低三个数量级；摘要未给出绝对误差、具体计算成本降低比例或更多定量指标。

title: Tandem jets in crossflow: the enclosed-recirculation momentum exchange and the unsteady shear-layer dynamics
summary: Twin tandem jets in crossflow are examined by 40\ kHz time-resolved particle image velocimetry (PIV) over nine spacing--velocity-ratio conditions ($L=2d$--$4d$, $r\approx3$--7; 68 twin cases, 11 single-jet records). The front jet is diluted: its trajectory lies below the single-jet reference, with a near-field segment up to 40\% shorter, and its velocity ratio falls to an effective value $r_{\mathrm{eff}}<r$, while the shielded rear jet rises above the reference. This paper identifies the carrier of that dilution and the unsteady dynamics that sustains it. The rear-jet blockage closes a gap recirculation whose reversed flow puts the two gap-side layers in the counter-current shear-layer configuration, the classical route to enhanced entrainment. The measured Reynolds stress and Prandtl mixing length show that the absolute exchange is nearly independent of the velocity ratio and exceeds the single-jet leeward zone like-for-like by up to $1.5\times$ (zone peak, across conditions) and $2.8\times$ (area-integrated) at $r\approx7$. The gain comes from an enlarged mixing scale rather than from a steeper shear, and the front-jet near-field shortening follows the absolute exchange transport rather than the twin/single enhancement ratio. The turbulent term exceeds the pressure term in eight of the nine conditions, and the flux budget reads the dilution as a limited mass addition plus a momentum loss to the crossflow; the evidence remains observational. The gap-side layers remain convectively unstable---DMD and SPOD find no growing mode within the resolvable band and record length---so the exchange is carried by convecting vortex trains rather than by a self-excited global mode.

AI.tldr: 在横流中双串列射流的40 kHz时间分辨PIV实验中，前射流受到稀释，后射流受到屏蔽并抬升；混合增强主要来自混合尺度增大，并由对流涡列输运，而不是由自激全局模态维持。
AI.motivation: 识别前射流稀释的载体及其非定常维持机制，量化双射流相对单射流的混合与动量交换增强，并判断间隙侧剪切层是否存在自激全局不稳定。
AI.method: 对9组间距-速比工况（L=2d–4d，r≈3–7；68个双射流记录、11个单射流记录）开展40 kHz时间分辨粒子图像测速；分析射流轨迹、有效速比、Reynolds应力、Prandtl混合长度和通量收支，并采用DMD与SPOD进行模态与稳定性分析。摘要未提供更详细的实验装置和不确定度信息。
AI.result: 前射流轨迹低于单射流参考，近场段最多缩短40%，有效速比reff<r；后射流轨迹高于参考。后射流阻塞形成间隙回流，其反向流使两侧间隙层构成逆流剪切层。绝对交换对速比近似不敏感；在r≈7时，相对单射流尾流区同口径比较，区域峰值最多为1.5倍、面积积分最多为2.8倍。增益源于混合尺度增大，而非剪切更陡。9组工况中有8组湍流项大于压力项。DMD和SPOD在可分辨频带与记录长度内未发现增长模态。
AI.conclusion: 前射流稀释由后射流阻塞形成的间隙回流及其逆流剪切层承载；通量收支表现为有限质量加入和向横流的动量损失；交换由对流涡列输运，间隙侧层保持对流不稳定而非自激全局模态。相关证据为观测性证据。

title: A second-order linear decoupled scheme with a relaxed zero-energy variable for Rayleigh-Bénard convection
summary: We construct a second-order, linear, and fully decoupled scheme for Rayleigh--Bénard convection between Navier-slip walls. The nonlinear terms are treated explicitly and multiplied by a scalar with exact value $1$ and no energy contributed to the continuous problem. As a result, each BDF2 step, with a rotational pressure correction, solves only constant-coefficient linear problems. For the time discretization, we prove that, for any time-step, the energy decays when the walls have equal temperatures, under a condition on the thermal weight, and the energy is bounded on finite time intervals when heated from below. Relaxing the scalar towards $1$ preserves both estimates. Energy stability does not control the accuracy of the scalar; the velocity and temperature fields are computed with its unrelaxed value, whose deviation from $1$ scales like $(E/C)(δt/τ)^3$ for kinetic energy $E$, time-scale $τ$ of the flow, and weight $C$ of the scalar equation. In our tests, choosing $C$ comparable to $E$ keeps this deviation small and doubles the largest time-step for which steady rolls are reproduced to a relative difference of $10^{-8}$. With Taylor--Hood elements, we observe second-order convergence in time, recover the critical Rayleigh numbers, and match published Nusselt numbers to within $0.5\%$. A three-dimensional implementation passes corresponding validation tests.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了用于 Navier-slip 壁面间 Rayleigh--Bénard 对流的二阶、线性且完全解耦格式：非线性项显式处理并乘以精确值为 1、不向连续问题贡献能量的标量，使每个带旋转压力修正的 BDF2 步仅求解常系数线性问题；论文证明能量稳定性，并给出标量偏差与时间步长、动能和热权重的标度关系，数值实验验证二阶时间收敛、临界 Rayleigh 数与 Nusselt 数精度，三维实现也通过验证。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在为 Navier-slip 壁面间的 Rayleigh--Bénard 对流构建二阶、线性、完全解耦且能量稳定的数值格式，使每个时间步只需处理常系数线性子问题；摘要未进一步明确说明研究动机的其他背景。
AI.method: 采用 BDF2 时间离散并结合旋转压力修正；非线性项显式处理，并乘以精确值为 1、对连续问题不贡献能量的标量，从而使每步完全解耦为常系数线性问题。空间离散使用 Taylor--Hood 单元，并实现三维版本。分析中证明：壁面温度相等时，在热权重条件下任意时间步长能量衰减；从下方加热时有限时间区间内能量有界；将标量松弛到 1 可保持这些估计。速度与温度场使用未松弛的标量值计算，其偏离 1 的尺度为 $(E/C)(\delta t/\tau)^3$。
AI.result: 理论结果表明格式具有上述能量稳定性，且松弛标量不破坏估计；但能量稳定性不控制标量精度，标量偏差按 $(E/C)(\delta t/\tau)^3$ 缩放。数值实验中，取 $C$ 与动能 $E$ 相当可使偏差较小，并将能复现稳态卷流且相对差异为 $10^{-8}$ 的最大时间步长提高一倍；使用 Taylor--Hood 单元观察到时间二阶收敛，复现临界 Rayleigh 数，Nusselt 数与已发表结果偏差在 $0.5\%$ 以内；三维实现通过相应验证测试。
AI.conclusion: 该二阶线性完全解耦 BDF2 旋转压力修正格式在 Navier-slip Rayleigh--Bénard 对流中兼具能量稳定性和计算效率，数值结果支持其二阶时间精度及对关键物理量的准确复现，三维实现亦可行；摘要未提供更多关于适用范围或局限性的结论。

title: Confinement of hybridized light modes in nonlinear-optical superpotentials
summary: In this work, we present a spatial and temporal light trapping mechanism induced by coherent frequency conversion. We consider a wave-mixing process, where a pumped nonlinearity mediates a frequency-domain beamsplitter interaction between two signal modes. When these wave modes are counterpropagating, temporally trapped eigenmodes emerge at the zero of the nonlinearity profile. We establish that such spatio-temporal trapping has a direct connection to supersymmetric quantum mechanics, which ensures the existence and robustness of the trapped modes and allows us to derive analytic solutions of the bound eigenmodes. Backwards sum-frequency conversion may thus enable a unique class of active photonic memory devices, whose design parameters are compatible with the state of the art in integrated nonlinear photonics. We propose proof-of-principle experiments to study this nonlinear-optical trapping effect on thin-film lithium niobate. In addition, as a case study, we show how the temporal trap can be used alongside parametric gain. Our work unveils potential applications ranging from classical integrated photonics to multimode quantum nonlinear photonics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由相干频率转换产生的空间与时间光捕获机制：在泵浦非线性介导两个信号模式间的频域分束器相互作用时，若模式反向传播，则会在非线性分布零点处出现时间捕获本征模；该现象与超对称量子力学相关，可给出解析本征模并启发了基于薄膜铌酸锂的验证实验及主动光子存储器等应用。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确展开具体研究背景，但指出该机制有望用于主动光子存储器件，并连接经典集成光子学与多模量子非线性光子学；其设计参数可与集成非线性光子学现状兼容。
AI.method: 考虑波混频过程，由泵浦非线性在兩個信号模式之间建立频域分束器相互作用；分析反向传播波模在非线性分布零点处的时间捕获本征模，建立其与超对称量子力学的联系以获得束缚本征模的解析解；并提出在薄膜铌酸锂上开展原理验证实验，同时以案例研究展示时间陷阱与参量增益结合的使用方式。

title: Extracting target-related flow structures using a time-lagged cross-correlation ranking criterion
summary: Structures with large global contributions to a flow field are not necessarily those that are most closely associated with a specified engineering observable. We propose a time-lagged cross-correlation (TCC) ranking criterion to extract target-related dynamical structures from a fixed modal expansion while preserving existing spatial modes and temporal coefficients. The criterion ranks mode groups by the mean squared norm of cross-responses between their flow contributions and the observable over a lag window. It is tested separately using dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) and proper orthogonal decomposition (POD). TCC-DMD analysis shows that TCC recovers three low-contribution target structures from a dominant background in a synthetic flow. The reconstruction error for the target subfield is 2.15\%. In the cylinder wake, different force observables select structures associated with the vortex-shedding fundamental, slow drag variations, and the second harmonic. In the cavity case, selected modes connect two main frequency bands of the target observable to distinct spatial amplitude and phase distributions. TCC-POD analysis shows that the criterion minimises the weighted truncation error of the correlation operator among equally sized subsets of the fixed orthogonal basis. A comparison with canonical correlation decomposition further reveals differences between fixed-direction selection and correlation-based basis construction in the spatial structure and retention of flow information. Lag aggregation can improve structure identification when zero-lag association is insufficient. The gains depend on the cross-response distribution and window selection. TCC separates target-related ranking from mode-set construction, enabling comparison of spatial structures associated with different observables within the same modal expansion.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种时间滞后互相关（TCC）排序准则，用于从固定模态展开中提取与指定工程可观测量相关的动力学结构，并分别结合DMD和POD进行验证。
AI.motivation: 流场中全局贡献大的结构不一定与特定工程可观测量最相关，因此需要在不改变现有空间模态和时间系数的前提下，分离目标相关排序与模态集构造。
AI.method: TCC按模态组对流动的贡献与可观测量在滞后窗口内交叉响应的均方范数对模态组排序；保持原有空间模态和时间系数不变，分别与DMD、POD结合测试，并与典型相关分解进行比较，同时考察滞后聚合。
AI.result: TCC-DMD在合成流中从主导背景中恢复三个低贡献目标结构，目标子场重构误差为2.15%；在圆柱尾流中，不同力可观测量选择与涡脱基频、慢阻力变化和二次谐波相关的结构；在空腔案例中，选中模态将目标观测量的两个主频带联系到不同空间幅值和相位分布。TCC-POD在等大小子集间最小化相关算子的加权截断误差；与典型相关分解比较揭示了固定方向选择与基于相关性的基构造在空间结构和流动信息保留上的差异；零滞后关联不足时，滞后聚合可改善结构识别，但增益取决于交叉响应分布和窗口选择。
AI.conclusion: TCC将目标相关排序与模态集构造分离，使不同可观测量对应的空间结构可在同一模态展开中比较。

title: Observation of Polarization Topology in Magneto-Optical BICs
summary: Polarization topology in momentum space is a fundamental characteristic of photonic bound states in the continuum (BICs), where the winding of far-field polarization defines a quantized topological charge. Although magneto-optical (MO) BICs combine polarization topology with magnetically tunable chirality, experimental characterization remains challenging because time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking complicates eigenpolarization extraction. Here, we experimentally resolve the momentum-space polarization topology of an MO BIC by reconstructing its two-dimensional far-field eigenpolarization texture. We extract the resonant output polarization using singular value decomposition of the polarization-resolved angle-resolved reflection matrix without invoking reciprocity. The reconstructed polarization azimuth winds counterclockwise by 2$π$ around the $Γ$-point singularity, yielding a topological charge of q = +1. Moreover, the polarization handedness can be reversed solely by varying the magnetic-bias strength, while the field direction and the measured topological charge remain unchanged. A non-Hermitian coupled-mode model traces this reversal to hybridization between the BIC mode and a leaky mode. This work establishes experimental access to momentum-space polarization topology in nonreciprocal photonics, opening a route to explore topological singularities and their evolution under active TRS breaking.

AI.tldr: 该文实验重建了磁光连续域束缚态（MO BIC）的二维远场本征偏振纹理，从而解析其动量空间偏振拓扑；测得绕Γ点的偏振方位角逆时针绕转2π、拓扑荷q=+1，并发现仅改变磁偏置强度即可反转偏振手性，而场方向与拓扑荷不变。
AI.motivation: 光子BIC的动量空间偏振拓扑由远场偏振绕转决定并可定义量子化拓扑荷；磁光BIC虽将偏振拓扑与磁可调手性结合，但时间反演对称性破缺使本征偏振提取困难，实验表征仍具挑战。
AI.method: 重建MO BIC的二维远场本征偏振纹理；对偏振分辨的角度分辨反射矩阵作奇异值分解，在不依赖互易性的条件下提取共振输出偏振；并用非厄米耦合模式模型解释观测结果。
AI.result: 重建的偏振方位角围绕Γ点奇点逆时针绕转2π，得到拓扑荷q=+1；仅通过改变磁偏置强度即可反转偏振手性，同时场方向和测得拓扑荷保持不变；非厄米耦合模式模型将手性反转归因于BIC模式与泄漏模式之间的杂化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在非互易光子学中实验访问动量空间偏振拓扑的途径，为探索拓扑奇点及其在主动时间反演对称性破缺下的演化提供了路径。

title: Quartz Crystal Microbalance impedance of discrete adsorbates with lubricated contact
summary: We present a thorough theoretical investigation of the shear force exerted on a horizontal plate undergoing fast (MHz range) longitudinal oscillations in presence of a spherical particle suspended in the liquid at close proximity to the plate. This hydrodynamic problem is relevant toward the analysis of frequency response (i.e., complex impedance) of Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) to discrete (particulate) adsorbates. For low areal density of adsorbates, the contributions of individual particles remain additive, rendering the theory applicable towards quantitative interpretation of the experimental measurements. For adsorbates much smaller than the viscous penetration depth, the closed-form analytical expressions for the complex impedance were derived for particles of arbitrary density, assuming a lubricated contact (i.e., non-localized adsorption). The theoretical predictions were shown to be in an excellent agreement with accurate Finite Element numerical computations. The validity of the theoretical approach was confirmed by QCM measurements conducted for polystyrene nanoparticles in a broad range of sizes, from 32 nm to 510 nm, adsorbing onto gold/silica sensor upon varying the oscillation frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了水平板在 MHz 级快速纵向振动时，对近板悬浮球形颗粒产生的剪切力，并据此分析 QCM 对颗粒状吸附物的复阻抗响应；在低面密度近似下给出解析表达，并用有限元计算和聚苯乙烯纳米颗粒实验验证。
AI.motivation: QCM 对离散颗粒吸附物的频率响应（复阻抗）需要定量理论解释；当吸附物面密度较低时，单个颗粒的贡献可近似叠加，因此有必要建立单颗粒近板情况下的流体动力学理论。
AI.method: 针对远小于黏性穿透深度的吸附颗粒，在润滑接触（非局域吸附）假设下，推导了适用于任意颗粒密度的复阻抗闭式解析表达式；并将理论预测与精确有限元数值计算进行比较，同时用 QCM 测量不同粒径聚苯乙烯纳米颗粒在 gold/silica 传感器上的吸附响应进行验证。
AI.result: 理论预测与有限元数值计算结果高度一致；QCM 实验覆盖 32 nm 至 510 nm 的聚苯乙烯纳米颗粒，并通过改变振动频率验证了理论方法的有效性。摘要未提供具体误差数值、完整频率范围及实验条件细节。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的理论可用于低面密度颗粒吸附条件下 QCM 复阻抗的定量解释，并得到数值计算与实验测量的支持。

title: Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; incl supporting information of 29 pages
summary: Mechanically compliant mirrors are key components in cavity optomechanics. However, the requirements to achieve the best optical and mechanical performance are usually in direct competition. A high reflectivity for tightly focused beams entails thick reflectors, whereas ultracoherent flexural nanomechanics necessitates thin membranes. We eliminate this trade-off by introducing high-refractive-index nanopillar metasurfaces on top of a thin membrane. We pattern a 50 micrometer-diameter array of nanopillars to form a photonic crystal. The flat band behavior of guided resonances in the photonic crystal enables a reflectivity of 99.82(1)% for a tightly focused beam of 7 micrometer waist. The combination of two guided resonances creates a 100 nanometer-wide high-reflectivity band around 1550 nanometer. Simultaneously, the nanopillar patterning realizes a density-modulated phononic crystal that isolates an ultracoherent localized mechanical mode with a $Q\cdot f$-product of $2\cdot 10^{14}$Hz. The demonstrated nanopillar metasurfaces enable lightweight mirrors for room-temperature quantum optomechanics and for use as levitated mirrors or lightsails.

AI.tldr: 通过在薄膜上引入高折射率纳米柱超表面，消除高反射率与超相干纳米机械性能之间的厚度矛盾，实现紧聚焦光束99.82(1)%反射率、1550 nm附近100 nm宽高反射带，以及Q·f为2×10^14 Hz的超相干局域机械模式。
AI.motivation: 腔光力学中的机械顺应性反射镜是关键部件，但最佳光学性能与机械性能通常直接冲突：紧聚焦光束的高反射率需要较厚反射体，而超相干弯曲纳米力学需要薄膜。本文旨在消除这一权衡。
AI.method: 在薄膜上图案化高折射率纳米柱超表面，形成50微米直径的纳米柱阵列光子晶体；利用光子晶体中导模共振的平带行为实现紧聚焦光束高反射，并通过两个导模共振组合形成高反射带；同时利用纳米柱图案化形成密度调制声子晶体，以隔离超相干局域机械模式。
AI.result: 对腰束为7微米的高聚焦光束实现99.82(1)%的反射率；在1550纳米附近形成100纳米宽的高反射带；实现Q·f乘积为2×10^14 Hz的超相干局域机械模式。
AI.conclusion: 所演示的纳米柱超表面可作为轻量反射镜，面向室温量子光力学，并可用于悬浮反射镜或光帆。摘要未提供更多关于制备细节、损耗机制或应用验证的信息。

title: GEM-PIC-RZ: a Galilean electromagnetic particle-in-cell code in quasi-cylindrical geometry with nonuniform grids
summary: Laser-plasma accelerators span scales from the micrometre wavelength of the driving laser to acceleration lengths of millimetres or metres. Full particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations resolve the laser carrier but are constrained by the Courant condition, whereas quasi-static models are computationally efficient but do not resolve it. We present GEM-PIC-RZ, a quasi-cylindrical implementation of the Galilean electromagnetic PIC scheme. The method retains the slow evolution of the forward field and therefore resolves the laser carrier while allowing a propagation step governed by the evolution of the laser and plasma rather than by the cell size. User-defined nonuniform grids and a charge-conserving regularization of the bubble closure support efficient simulations across these scales. Comparisons with the full PIC code FBPIC show agreement for the laser wake, the depletion and redshift of a few-cycle pulse, and ionization injection; the measured CPU time is about 2\,\% of that for FBPIC in the reported runs; the injected charge carries a model uncertainty of about 15\,\% from the regularization. An envelope model, in contrast, underestimates the depletion of the few-cycle pulse fivefold. Self-injection in a sharp density down-ramp is not yet reproduced and remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出准柱坐标伽利略电磁PIC方法GEM-PIC-RZ，可在分辨激光载波的同时以远低于全PIC的计算成本模拟激光等离子体加速器中的多尺度过程。
AI.motivation: 全粒子PIC可分辨激光载波但受Courant条件限制，准静态模型计算高效却不分辨载波；因此需要一种跨越微米激光波长到毫米或米级加速长度、既能分辨载波又计算高效的模拟方法。
AI.method: 提出GEM-PIC-RZ，即伽利略电磁PIC方案的准柱坐标实现；保留前向场的慢演化以分辨激光载波，并使传播步长由激光与等离子体演化而非网格尺寸决定；支持用户定义非均匀网格，并采用保持电荷守恒的泡闭合正则化。

title: Predicting droplet landing in angle-controlled surface acoustic wave jetting
summary: Nozzle-free droplet generation eliminates the need for a dispensing orifice, but useful printing also requires control over where droplets are deposited. Here we demonstrate predictable droplet deposition using a nozzle-free, angle-controlled surface acoustic wave jetting platform. Opposing focused interdigital transducers steer droplets from a pendant parent drop toward a collection substrate, with the ejection angle set by the time-integrated acoustic acceleration imbalance. The overall acceleration ratio identifies the operating window for single-droplet ejection and separates it from no-ejection, satellite-droplet, and multiple-droplet regimes. We then connect ejection angle to landing position through a geometric deposition model referenced to a balanced shot in each experiment. At a 5.2 mm parent-drop-to-substrate spacing, 80 steered shots across twenty experiments show strongly anisotropic relative placement scatter: 0.59 mm in the steering direction and 0.06 mm transverse to it. In tests conducted independently over several days, a model calibrated on six earlier collection dates predicted landing positions on two later dates with a root-mean-square error of 0.71 mm; bootstrap resampling placed the 95% confidence range for this error between 0.41 and 1.01 mm. The results establish a practical framework for predicting relative droplet landing in angle-controlled surface acoustic wave jetting and identify the limits imposed by steering angle, separation distance, and actuation regime from an orifice-free, clog-free droplet ejection method.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种无喷嘴、角度可控的声表面波喷射平台，通过相对布置的聚焦叉指换能器调控液滴喷射角，并建立几何沉积模型预测液滴落点；在5.2 mm间距下区分单液滴喷射窗口，跨日预测落点的RMSE为0.71 mm。
AI.motivation: 无喷嘴液滴生成可省去分配孔口，但实际打印仍需控制液滴沉积位置，因此需要一种无需孔口且能可预测落点沉积的液滴喷射与操控方法。
AI.method: 采用无喷嘴、角度可控的声表面波喷射平台：相对布置的聚焦叉指换能器将悬挂母液滴中的液滴导向收集基底，喷射角由时间积分声学加速度失衡决定；总体加速度比用于识别单液滴喷射工作窗口，并区分不喷射、卫星液滴和多液滴区域。随后以每次实验中平衡射击为参考的几何沉积模型，将喷射角与落点位置关联。模型在6个较早采集日期上校准，并在2个较晚日期上独立测试；实验采用5.2 mm母液滴-基底间距，共20次实验、80次转向射击，并用bootstrap重采样估计误差置信区间。摘要未提供液滴体积、喷射速度及基底材质等细节。

title: A New Twist on Astigmatic Transformation: Beyond Laguerre-Gaussian Beams
summary: Astigmatic transformation is widely used to convert the azimuthal phase structure of Laguerre-Gaussian vortex beams into intensity patterns from which the topological charge can be read out. Here, we show that this phase-to-intensity conversion is not just restricted to the Laguerre-Gaussian radial profile. We derive analytical expressions for the astigmatically transformed high-order Bessel--Gauss and perfect optical vortex fields, and find that, despite their substantially different radial structures, the number of intensity minima is directly set by the accumulated azimuthal phase winding. Numerical simulations and experimental measurements on both beam families confirm this result, establishing astigmatic transformation as a direct probe of the topological charge of scalar structured optical fields. We further extend the approach to non-separable vector Bessel-Gauss beams, in which the spatial and polarization degrees of freedom are coupled, and show that polarization-resolved detection allows the topological charge of the constituent spatial modes to be determined independently.

AI.tldr: 该文研究像散变换对高阶贝塞尔-高斯光束和完美涡旋光束的相位-强度转换，证明强度极小值数目由累积方位相位缠绕决定，并通过仿真与实验验证；进一步将该方法推广到不可分离矢量贝塞尔-高斯光束，实现偏振分辨的拓扑电荷独立检测。
AI.motivation: 像散变换常用于将拉盖尔-高斯涡旋光束的方位相位结构转换为可读出拓扑电荷的强度图案，但该方法是否仅适用于拉盖尔-高斯径向分布尚需检验；作者希望将像散变换确立为更通用的标量结构光场拓扑电荷直接探测手段，并推广到空间与偏振自由度耦合的矢量光束。
AI.method: 推导高阶贝塞尔-高斯光束和完美光学涡旋场经像散变换后的解析表达式；对两类光束进行数值仿真和实验测量；进一步针对不可分离矢量贝塞尔-高斯光束，利用偏振分辨探测分析其组成空间模式的拓扑电荷。

title: Synthetic 2D magnetic turbulence with controlled island structuring
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, accepted for Journal of Plasma Physics
summary: Magnetic turbulence remains up to this day not fully understood, despite its important role in the behavior of plasmas. A recurring ingredient in plasma turbulence is the spontaneous formation and evolution of plasmoids. These represent magnetic islands on current sheets in two-dimensional turbulent magnetic fields that are consistently found in high-resolution direct numerical simulations (DNSs) using a magnetohydrodynamic description. However, such simulations require considerable amounts of computational power. Synthetic turbulence models provide an alternative, cheap approach to the generation of fully-developed turbulent fields. In this work, we first present an extension of our open-source, general synthetic turbulence BxC toolkit that is specifically tailored to generate 2D turbulent magnetic fields. We then use a novel physically motivated, but purely geometric construction that generates current sheet island chains, which results in fields that visually match the ones obtained through DNSs. We show how this construction affects the magnetic field lines and find a correlation with the formation of magnetic O-points and X-points. The magnetic flux and size of the islands in the field are found to match well with theoretical scaling laws. Lastly, we show BxC's capabilities by generating a 2D $N\times N$ turbulent magnetic field of resolution $N = 100000$, going beyond the state-of-the-art reached by simulations, on a single CPU with modest computational resources. Our construction maintains direct control over the inertial range, and allows to make morphological changes to the plasmoids and fields, demonstrating plasmoid appearance, disappearance and merging.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展开源合成湍流工具 BxC，提出一种纯几何构造来生成二维湍流磁场中的电流片磁岛链，并将其与直接数值模拟（DNS）结果及理论标度律进行比较；该方法可在单 CPU 上生成 N=100000 的二维 N×N 湍流磁场，并可调控等离子体团的形态变化。
AI.motivation: 磁湍流在等离子体行为中很重要但尚未被完全理解；等离子体团（plasmoid）即二维湍流磁场电流片上的磁岛，在高分辨率磁流体 DNS 中常见，但 DNS 计算成本很高。合成湍流模型提供了一种廉价替代方案，用于生成充分发展的湍流场。
AI.method: 作者首先扩展其开源、通用的合成湍流 BxC 工具包，使其专门用于生成二维湍流磁场；随后采用一种新的、具有物理动机但纯几何的构造来生成电流片磁岛链。文中分析了该构造对磁力线的影响，考察其与磁 O 点和 X 点形成的相关性，并检验磁岛磁通和尺寸是否符合理论标度律。最后用 BxC 在单 CPU 和有限计算资源下生成 N=100000 的二维 N×N 湍流磁场，并展示对惯性范围的控制及对等离子体团和磁场的形态调整能力。
AI.result: 生成的磁场在视觉上与 DNS 得到的场相匹配；该构造影响磁力线并与磁 O 点和 X 点的形成相关；磁岛磁通和尺寸与理论标度律吻合良好。BxC 可在单 CPU、有限计算资源下生成 N=100000 的二维 N×N 湍流磁场，超过模拟所达到的当前水平；该构造还能保持对惯性范围的直接控制，并实现等离子体团的出现、消失和合并。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于 BxC 的合成湍流方法与纯几何电流片磁岛链构造能够高效生成具有等离子体团结构的二维湍流磁场，并重现与 DNS 相似的形态及理论标度关系，同时提供对惯性范围和磁岛形态的控制。摘要未说明该方法在三维、其他等离子体参数或完全替代 DNS 方面的适用性。

title: GeoDiv KAN Solver for Time Fractional Navier Stokes Equations on Complex Domains to Realistic CFD Reconstruction
summary: Scientific machine learning provides a promising framework for solving complex problems in science and engineering. Notably, physics informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown considerable potential for solving differential equations and modelling engineering systems. Solving time fractional Navier Stokes equations (TFNSEs) on complex domains is challenging due to temporal nonlocality, nonlinear flow dynamics, geometric complexity, and incompressibility constraints. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry gated, divergence-free Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov Arnold network (GeoDiv KAN). The proposed architecture uses geometry dependent feature gating and a streamfunction formulation to preserve incompressibility by construction. GeoDiv KAN is evaluated for the time fractional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on square, circular, and star-shaped domains. Numerical experiments show that GeoDiv KAN achieves higher predictive accuracy than PINN, PIKAN, RBF KAN, and DF RBFKAN across the considered benchmark problems. To establish practical relevance, GeoDiv KAN is applied to two data driven CFD cases: unsteady flow past a circular cylinder using the \href{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5039610}{Zenodo dataset} and turbulent RANS flow through a complex U bend using the \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/JDecke/ubend-cfd}{U-bend dataset}.

AI.tldr: 提出几何门控、无散度的高斯径向基函数Kolmogorov-Arnold网络GeoDiv KAN，用于在复杂区域求解时间分数阶不可压Navier-Stokes方程；在方形、圆形和星形区域上预测精度优于PINN、PIKAN、RBF KAN和DF RBFKAN，并应用于圆柱绕流与U型弯管RANS两个CFD数据案例。
AI.motivation: 在复杂区域求解时间分数阶Navier-Stokes方程面临时间非局部性、非线性流动动力学、几何复杂性和不可压约束等挑战；PINNs虽已用于微分方程和工程系统建模，但上述问题仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出GeoDiv KAN：采用几何相关的特征门控，并结合流函数形式，使不可压性在构造上得到满足；网络结合高斯径向基函数与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络结构。在方形、圆形和星形区域上评估时间分数阶不可压Navier-Stokes方程。
AI.result: 数值实验显示GeoDiv KAN在所考虑基准问题上预测精度高于PINN、PIKAN、RBF KAN和DF RBFKAN；并应用于两个数据驱动CFD案例：基于Zenodo数据集的圆柱非定常绕流，以及基于U-bend数据集的复杂U型弯管湍流RANS流动。摘要未给出具体误差指标、计算成本或消融结果。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明GeoDiv KAN是求解复杂区域时间分数阶不可压Navier-Stokes方程的有效方法，并具有用于实际CFD场景的潜力；但未提供定量结论、泛化性分析或局限性讨论。

title: Second- and third-order nonlinearities in silicon nitride waveguides via heterogeneous integration of lithium niobate membranes
summary: Thick, dispersion-engineered silicon nitride is a leading platform for integrated third-order nonlinear optics, supporting supercontinuum and frequency comb generation. However, it lacks the second-order nonlinearity required by many applications. Here we bond pre-fabricated x-cut thin-film lithium niobate membranes onto finished silicon nitride waveguides as a back-end step, compatible with commercially fabricated waveguides. A single silicon nitride waveguide generates an octave-spanning supercontinuum and, through the lithium niobate membrane, concurrent second-harmonic, sum- and difference-frequency generation. These results open new possibilities for thick silicon nitride photonics, from visible light generation to on-chip $f$-$2f$ comb self-referencing, a key step towards miniaturised timing and navigation quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 作者将预制x切薄膜铌酸锂膜键合到已完成的氮化硅波导上，在单一波导中同时实现倍频程超连续谱以及二次谐波、和频与差频产生，为厚氮化硅光子学引入二阶非线性。
AI.motivation: 厚色散工程氮化硅是集成三阶非线性光学的重要平台，可支持超连续谱与频率梳，但缺乏许多应用所需的二阶非线性。
AI.method: 作为后端步骤，将预制x切薄膜铌酸锂膜键合到已完成的氮化硅波导上，并与商用制备波导兼容；利用单一氮化硅波导与铌酸锂膜实现非线性过程。
AI.result: 单一氮化硅波导产生倍频程超连续谱，并通过铌酸锂膜同时产生二次谐波、和频与差频。摘要未提供转换效率、带宽、损耗等定量指标。

title: On Spurious Mesh-Scale Oscillations Associated with Resonance-Cone Regimes in Wave-Plasma Simulations
summary: Spurious mesh-scale oscillations can compromise frequency-domain finite-element simulations of electromagnetic wave propagation in magnetized cold plasmas. We investigate their origin and mitigation through a verification framework combining a mixed Nédélec-Lagrange solver, a waveport accommodating non-orthogonal modes in anisotropic media, and an analytical generalized Fresnel benchmark at a vacuum-plasma interface. Comparisons with this benchmark show that the observed oscillations occur in resonance-cone regimes and are absent from the analytical fields, confirming their numerical origin. Systematic tests assess the effects of approximation order, variational formulation, mesh geometry, and numerical collisionality. Plane-wave residual and Fourier spectral analyses suggest that local mesh variations induce spectral coupling to additional wavevector components, predominantly populating the dispersion branches in collisionless resonance-cone regimes where the reduced scalar equation loses ellipticity. Uniform rectangular grids recover the analytical wave structure, further supporting the role of mesh geometry and symmetry. However, strict symmetry requirements limit the applicability of this approach, motivating numerical regularization. In resonance-cone regimes, introducing sufficient numerical collisionality suppresses the mesh-scale oscillations, yielding smooth electric-field solutions and reducing the error relative to the analytical benchmark. For one resonance-cone benchmark configuration, the error-minimizing damping decreases with mesh refinement according to an empirical $Z_{\mathrm n}\propto h^{1.48}$ scaling, sustaining error reduction consistent with second-order convergence and avoiding the accuracy limit imposed by fixed collisionality. ...

AI.tldr: 该文研究磁化冷等离子体频域有限元电磁仿真中虚假网格尺度振荡的来源与抑制方法，并通过解析基准与数值实验确认其数值起源，提出以数值碰撞性进行正则化。
AI.motivation: 虚假的网格尺度振荡会损害磁化冷等离子体中电磁波传播的频域有限元仿真，因此需要查明其产生机制并寻找有效的抑制手段。
AI.method: 构建验证框架，结合混合Nédélec-Lagrange求解器、可处理各向异性介质中非正交模式的波端口，以及真空-等离子体界面上的广义Fresnel解析基准；系统测试近似阶数、变分形式、网格几何和数值碰撞性的影响，并使用平面波残差与Fourier谱分析；同时比较均匀矩形网格与数值正则化策略。
AI.result: 与解析基准对比表明，振荡出现在共振锥区域且不存在于解析场中，确认其为数值起源；局部网格变化会引起向额外波矢分量的谱耦合，主要在无碰撞共振锥区域填充色散支，此区域约化标量方程失去椭圆性。均匀矩形网格可恢复解析波结构，支持网格几何与对称性的作用，但严格对称要求限制其适用性。在共振锥区域引入足够数值碰撞性可抑制网格尺度振荡，获得光滑电场解并降低相对解析基准的误差；某一基准配置下，误差最小化阻尼随网格细化按经验标度 Z_n ∝ h^1.48 减小，使误差降低与二阶收敛一致，并避免固定碰撞性造成的精度限制。
AI.conclusion: 网格尺度振荡主要源于网格变化诱发的谱耦合及无碰撞共振锥区域中约化标量方程失去椭圆性，属于数值伪影；数值碰撞性正则化能有效抑制振荡并保持收敛性，均匀矩形网格虽可恢复解析结构但适用性受对称性限制。摘要未提供具体误差数值、完整参数范围及三维推广结果。

title: Evaporative Cooling and Secondary Combustion in a Liquid-Hydrocarbon Rotating Detonation Combustor with Dual-Purpose Head-End Injection
summary: The rotating detonation engine (RDE) faces severe thermal protection challenges. This study numerically investigates a head-end dual-purpose injection configuration in which the film-cooling holes act as both fuel and coolant injectors. An Eulerian-Lagrangian framework is employed, in which the turbulence closure, the film-cooling effectiveness prediction, and the droplet evaporation model are validated against experimental benchmarks. The validated framework is then applied to examine the effects of coolant flow rate, atomization quality, and the fuel allocation between the main flow and the cooling system. Beyond a threshold coolant flow rate the wall temperature drops substantially, whereas an excessively low flow rate elevates it by intensifying local deflagration, revealing a competition between evaporative cooling and secondary combustion that is inherent to this dual-purpose configuration. Fine droplets cool effectively but only over a limited distance downstream, and fuel allocated to cooling weakens the detonation wave and reduces thrust. A moderate coolant flow rate combined with fine atomization is therefore recommended.

AI.tldr: 该文采用欧拉-拉格朗日数值框架研究旋转爆震发动机头部薄膜冷却孔兼作燃料与冷却剂喷注的双用途方案，分析冷却流量、雾化质量及燃料在主流动与冷却系统间分配的影响，并推荐中等冷却流量配合细雾化。
AI.motivation: 旋转爆震发动机面临严峻热防护挑战，研究将薄膜冷却孔同时用作燃料和冷却剂喷注器的头部双用途构型，以兼顾热防护与推进性能。
AI.method: 采用欧拉-拉格朗日框架，其中湍流闭合模型、薄膜冷却效率预测和液滴蒸发模型均针对实验基准进行验证；随后将验证后的框架用于考察冷却剂流量、雾化质量以及主流与冷却系统之间的燃料分配。

title: Shaping Near Fields of Photonic Modes into Topological Textures
summary: Topological textures of light, such as optical vortices and skyrmions, are attractive for high-density information encoding and light-matter interactions. In the near field, topologies have primarily been realized using polaritonic platforms that inherently tie the platform to the material dispersion, limiting their footprint due to propagation losses and restricting their operating spectral region. Here, we introduce a route to shape near-field topologies through the geometric engineering of a dielectric metasurface supporting a quasi-bound state in the continuum resonance, without the need for polaritonic surface waves. In-plane deformation of our metasurface bars conserves their resonance-driven near-fields locally, so that the metasurface geometry and the polarization of the illuminating light dictate the generated topology. By shaping silicon unit cells into geometries with rotational symmetry, we create optical topologies with controllable topological charge. Using phase-resolved scattering-type near-field optical microscopy, we experimentally characterize high-purity resonance-locked topologies such as vortices in concentric rings and topological charge doublets in Archimedean spirals. In contrast to conventional topological textures, our purely photonic mode-based field textures are stationary standing waves in the radial direction, without relying on surface-wave propagation or polaritonic dispersion, establishing a spectrally and spatially scalable platform for near-field topological photonics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并实验验证了一种无需极化激元表面波的近场拓扑构筑方法：利用支持准连续域束缚态共振的介质超表面，通过几何工程与照明偏振调控近场拓扑，并在硅基超表面上实现可调拓扑荷的涡旋与拓扑荷双重态。

title: Nonlinear Drift Waves and Electrostatic Density Cavities in Upper Ionosphere
summary: Nonlinear drift waves are investigated to explain the mechanism for the creation of one dimensional (1D) and two dimensional (2D) electrostatic density cavities in the presence of density gradient in direction perpendicular to the geomagnetic field. Ion motion along field lines has to be neglected for the formation of density depletion because nonlinear contribution of their parallel motion overcomes the effect of drift waves which create negative nonlinear potential. It is pointed out that a straightforward but appropriate model for drift waves can explain the generation of density cavities having widths in xy-plane if the external magnetic field is assumed to be along z-axis i.e. ${\bf B}_0 = B_0 \hat{z}$. The general nonlinear equation for drift waves takes the form of Zakharov-Kuznetson (ZK) equation when ion nonlinear vorticity term is ignored and it admits the solution in the form of 2D solitary wave. In 1D case, the ZK equation reduces to Korteweg de Vries (KdV) equation which admits solution in the form of 1D soliton. In both cases, the nonlinear potential becomes negative. The order of magnitude of the amplitude and width of density cavities is found to be in agreement with the satellite observations in upper ionosphere.

AI.tldr: 本文用非线性漂移波研究垂直于地磁场方向的密度梯度背景下，一维和二维静电密度腔的生成机制；模型可化为ZK方程并给出二维孤立波解，一维情形退化为KdV方程并给出一维孤子解，非线性势为负，所得密度腔幅度和宽度量级与上层电离层卫星观测一致。

title: Modulation theory of Y- and X-wave Kadomtsev--Petviashvili solitons
summary: The evolution of long wavelength perturbations of traveling wave 2-soliton solutions of the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili II (KP) equation are investigated using modulation theory. An initial-boundary value problem for a system of hyperbolic conservation laws is formulated for amplitude and slope perturbations to soliton legs of the resonant (Y-shaped) and X-shaped KP traveling wave solutions. The vertex where individuated soliton legs coalesce is modeled as a moving free boundary where information between the soliton legs can pass. The linearized hyperbolic system is proven to be well-posed under suitable initial conditions and is solved exactly. In the case of the resonant Y-shaped soliton, all admissible simple (rarefaction) waves of the nonlinear system are characterized. Specific perturbations of Y-waves can lead to the dimensionality of the modulated solution changing, corresponding to a physical geometric change to the multi-soliton pattern. Spontaneous leg deletion and leg creation can occur. The conditions under which the Y-wave modulation system can experience gradient catastrophe are given. Gradient catastrophe is regularized by the formation of a new leg, with an augmented modulation system proposed to describe the growth of the new leg. On the other hand, the X-wave system can be reduced to two independent line soliton modulation systems. These findings reinforce the prevalence and generality of resonant Y-shaped vertices in the KP II system and applications.The theoretical modulation predictions are supported by direct numerical simulations of KP II, which show good agreement with the analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文用调制理论研究KP II方程行波2-孤子解的长波扰动演化，建立并求解振幅与斜率扰动的双曲守恒律初边值问题，分析Y形与X形孤子顶点及梯度灾难，并用数值模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 研究Kadomtsev-Petviashvili II（KP）方程行波2-孤子解的长波扰动演化，理解共振Y形和X形多孤子结构中孤子腿及其顶点的稳定性与动力学。
AI.method: 采用调制理论，将共振Y形和X形KP行波解的孤子腿的振幅与斜率扰动表述为双曲守恒律系统的初边值问题；将孤子腿汇合的顶点建模为可传递信息的移动自由边界；证明线性化双曲系统在适当初始条件下适定并精确求解；对Y形情形刻画非线性系统所有容许的简单波（稀疏波），给出梯度灾难条件并提出新增孤子腿的增广调制系统；对X形情形约化为两个独立的线孤子调制系统；并用KP II直接数值模拟验证理论预测。

title: The Mechanism of Chirality in Plasmonic Structures: Asymmetric Resonance Modes
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, and 2 tables. The manuscript investigates the physical mechanism underlying circular dichroism in coupled plasmonic nanostructures through qualitative and quantitative analyses of asymmetric resonant responses
summary: This study presents a theoretical framework for understanding the mechanism of chirality generation and circular dichroism (CD) in chiral nanostructures, with a particular focus on the role of asymmetric plasmon resonance mode distributions. Although previous studies have linked chiroptical properties to resonance differences, the specific nature and origin of these differences have not been fully elucidated. Here, we provide a more detailed explanation by quantitatively analyzing the asymmetric electric-field components arising from mode asymmetry. Specifically, we examine the near-field symmetry of individual nanorods and corner-stacked coupled structures (CSCS). The results demonstrate that chirality arises from asymmetric electric-field distributions, which give rise to distinct phase and amplitude responses of the electromagnetic fields in the composite structure under right-handed circularly polarized (RCP) and left-handed circularly polarized (LCP) illumination. The absorption and CD spectra, which exhibit distinct features around $910\,\mathrm{nm}$, support this mechanism and provide valuable insights into the design of chiroptical materials. The proposed mechanism is not restricted to a specific chiral structure or resonance and offers a broader explanation for the generation of circular dichroism.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个理论框架，用于解释手性纳米结构中手性产生及圆二色性（CD）的机制，核心是等离激元共振模式的不对称分布；通过分析单个纳米棒与角堆叠耦合结构（CSCS）的近场对称性及RCP/LCP光照下的场响应，指出不对称电场分布导致相位与振幅差异，并由约910 nm处的吸收与CD光谱特征支持该机制。
AI.motivation: 已有研究将手性光学性质与共振差异联系起来，但这些差异的具体性质与起源尚未被充分阐明，因此需要更细致地解释手性产生和CD的机制。
AI.method: 构建理论框架，定量分析由模式不对称产生的非对称电场分量；考察单个纳米棒和角堆叠耦合结构（CSCS）的近场对称性，并分析复合结构在右旋圆偏振（RCP）与左旋圆偏振（LCP）光照下电磁场的相位和振幅响应，同时结合吸收谱与CD谱进行支持性分析。
AI.result: 结果表明，手性来源于不对称电场分布，该分布使复合结构在RCP与LCP光照下呈现不同的电磁场相位和振幅响应；吸收谱和CD谱在约910 nm处表现出明显特征，支持该机制，并为手性光学材料设计提供启示。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的机制不局限于特定手性结构或特定共振，可为圆二色性的产生提供更广泛的解释，并有助于手性光学材料的设计。

title: Self-gravitating isothermal equilibria in Eddington-inspired Born--Infeld gravity: exact planar sheets and the Bonnor--Ebert critical mass
summary: We study self-gravitating fluid equilibria in the Newtonian limit of Eddington-inspired Born--Infeld (EiBI) gravity, in which the Poisson equation acquires a term proportional to the Laplacian of the density. We show that this term is equivalent, for arbitrary flows, to an effective pressure $p+χρ^2/8$, so that equilibrium and radial stability reduce exactly to Newtonian problems with a modified equation of state. For pressure-bounded isothermal spheres we compute the EiBI generalization of the Bonnor--Ebert critical mass as a function of the single parameter $\varepsilon=χP_{\rm ext}/4c_s^4$, and confirm each change of stability with a radial-pulsation analysis. Near $\varepsilon=0$ the critical mass grows as $M_{\rm BE}(1+5.74\,\varepsilon)$. For $\varepsilon>0.0302$ no isothermal sphere is radially unstable, so a positive EiBI parameter removes the Bonnor--Ebert instability; for smaller positive $\varepsilon$ a stable high-density branch supported by the EiBI pressure follows the unstable one. For $\varepsilon<-0.154$ the mass limit is set instead by the vanishing of the central effective sound speed, and is a loss of equilibrium rather than an instability. In planar geometry the same reduction yields an exact first integral, closed-form isothermal sheets with a maximum column density $2c_s^2/\sqrt{πG|χ|}$ for $χ<0$, and a complete classification of adiabatic $γ=3$ sheets.

AI.tldr: 该文在Eddington-inspired Born–Infeld引力的牛顿极限下，将泊松方程中的密度拉普拉斯项化为有效压强 p+χρ²/8，从而把平衡与径向稳定性严格映射为修改状态方程的牛顿问题；据此给出压力有界等温球的广义Bonnor–Ebert临界质量、稳定性判据及平面等温/绝热片精确解。
AI.motivation: 摘要未展开更广泛的学科动机，只说明要研究EiBI牛顿极限下自引力流体平衡及其稳定性，尤其是密度拉普拉斯修正对Bonnor–Ebert不稳定性和平面解结构的影响。
AI.method: 对任意流场证明密度拉普拉斯项等价于有效压强 p+χρ²/8，使平衡和径向稳定性可化为修改状态方程的牛顿问题；对压力有界等温球以 ε=χP_ext/(4c_s^4) 为单参数计算EiBI版Bonnor–Ebert临界质量，并用径向脉动分析核对稳定性变化；在平面几何中用同一约化求首次积分、闭式等温片及γ=3绝热片分类。
AI.result: 近 ε=0 时临界质量按 M_BE(1+5.74ε) 增长；ε>0.0302 时不存在径向不稳定的等温球，正EiBI参数消除Bonnor–Ebert不稳定性；较小正ε下不稳定分支之后出现由EiBI压强支撑的稳定高密度分支；ε<−0.154 时质量上限由中心有效声速消失决定，属于平衡丧失而非不稳定性。平面情形得到精确首次积分、χ<0时最大柱密度 2c_s²/√(πG|χ|) 的闭式等温片，以及γ=3绝热片的完整分类。
AI.conclusion: EiBI修正可通过等效压强统一处理平衡与径向稳定性，并显著改变等温球的临界质量和稳定性图景：足够大的正参数可去除Bonnor–Ebert不稳定性，足够负的参数则使质量极限转为平衡丧失；同一框架还给出平面自引力片的精确解和分类。

title: Anisotropic spin hydrodynamics in a magnetized medium: entropy-current formulation and minimal linear modes
summary: We formulate anisotropic relativistic spin hydrodynamics in a parity-even magnetized medium using an Israel--Stewart entropy-current construction. Treating the magnetic field at leading order in the gradient expansion reduces the rotational symmetry to $SO(2)$ and separates spin susceptibilities and dissipative transport into longitudinal, transverse, and mixed channels. A restricted quadratic entropy current yields transient equations for the retained dissipative stresses and spin fluxes. We analyze a minimal linear closure around an unpolarized homogeneous equilibrium, retaining dynamical magnetic-flux perturbations but no explicit spin-magnetization coupling; spin and magnetic fluctuations mix through the fluid variables. Infrared coefficient equations and ultraviolet characteristic expansions organize the magnetosonic and Alfvén-like spectra together with spectator spin-flux poles. The first-order truncation exhibits unstable boost-sector poles and superlinear large-wave-number branches, interpreted as diagnostics of the truncated equations rather than microscopic dispersion predictions. For the baseline parameters, finite relaxation times yield asymptotically linear propagation branches and finite relaxation poles, with no growing modes found on the sampled grid. The characteristic speeds depend nonmonotonically on spin transport and provide necessary light-cone diagnostics, without establishing general stability or strong hyperbolicity.

AI.tldr: 本文在宇称偶的磁化介质中，用Israel-Stewart熵流构造建立各向异性相对论自旋流体力学；磁场在梯度展开领头阶使旋转对称性降为SO(2)，并将自旋磁化率与耗散输运分解为纵向、横向和混合通道，进而分析线性扰动谱及截断方程的稳定性诊断。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机；其直接目标是构建并分析磁化介质中的各向异性相对论自旋流体力学框架，尤其考察自旋与磁场涨落通过流体变量混合后的线性谱和截断行为。
AI.method: 采用Israel-Stewart熵流构造；将磁场置于梯度展开领头阶，使旋转对称性约化为SO(2)，并把自旋磁化率和耗散输运分为纵向、横向、混合通道；用受限的二次熵流得到保留的耗散应力和自旋流的瞬态方程；在未极化均匀平衡附近作最小线性闭合，保留动力学磁通扰动但不含显式自旋-磁化耦合；通过红外系数方程和紫外特征展开组织磁声、类Alfvén谱及旁观自旋流极点，并比较一阶截断与有限弛豫时间情形。
