title: Effective-action formulation of $\mathbf{k}$-odd bianisotropy and unidirectional polarization rotation in nonlocal temporal metamaterials
summary: We derive the effective action of temporal metamaterials up to first order in spatial derivatives through a multiscale analysis of the electromagnetic Lagrangian density. We show that the first-order spatial correction gives rise to an effective bianisotropic coupling tensor that is odd in the wavevector $\mathbf{k}$. Remarkably, chiral, pseudochiral, and omega-type bianisotropic responses emerge as distinct directional manifestations of a single nonlocal coupling tensor, even when the underlying electric and magnetic response tensors remain symmetric. Furthermore, we establish a framework for analyzing Lorentz reciprocity based on the Hessian of the effective action. We demonstrate that Lorentz reciprocity is preserved in the presence of omega-type coupling but is broken when chiral or pseudochiral coupling emerges. This nonreciprocity manifests as the unidirectional rotations of normalized Stokes vectors incurred by Floquet-engineered chirality and pseudochirality.

AI.tldr: 论文通过电磁拉格朗日密度的多尺度分析，推导时变超材料至空间一阶导数的有效作用量，发现非局域双各向异性耦合统一产生手性、赝手性和omega型响应，并用有效作用量的Hessian建立Lorentz互易性判据。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机；论文直接针对时变超材料的有效作用量开展至空间一阶导数的推导，并建立基于有效作用量Hessian的Lorentz互易性分析框架。
AI.method: 对电磁拉格朗日密度进行多尺度分析，推导时变超材料至空间一阶导数的有效作用量；利用有效作用量的Hessian构建Lorentz互易性分析框架。
AI.result: 一阶空间修正产生对波矢k为奇函数的有效双各向异性耦合张量；手性、赝手性和omega型双各向异性响应是同一非局域耦合张量的不同方向表现，即使底层电场和磁场响应张量保持对称；omega型耦合下Lorentz互易性保持，而手性或赝手性耦合出现时互易性破缺，并表现为Floquet工程手性和赝手性引起的归一化Stokes矢量单向旋转。
AI.conclusion: 时变超材料的非局域双各向异性可由单一对波矢为奇函数的耦合张量统一描述，Hessian框架可区分保持与破缺Lorentz互易性的耦合类型；手性和赝手性耦合可导致非互易的偏振/Stokes矢量单向旋转，而omega型耦合不破坏互易性。

title: Experimental evidence of forward energy transfer induced by core-edge coupling in multiscale tokamak turbulence
summary: Turbulence in magnetically confined plasmas is inherently quasi-two-dimensional and can exhibit both inverse and forward energy transfer across scales. Experimental evidence for cross-scale energy transfer in the hot plasma core has, however, remained scarce. Understanding such energy transfer is crucial because it governs turbulent transport, which directly impacts confinement quality of fusion plasmas. Here we report experimental evidence consistent with forward energy transfer associated with core-edge coupling in tokamak turbulence. We combined multichannel collective Thomson scattering (CTS) and radially localized Doppler backscattering (DBS) to resolve cross-scale fluctuation dynamics. The results reveal that a quasi-coherent mode (QCM) originating from the edge is also present in the core and resonantly couples with broadband turbulence, producing significant forward energy transfer and characteristic secondary instabilities. These combined measurements indicate that quasi-two-dimensional tokamak turbulence can support a net energy transfer from ion to electron scales through cross-scale wave-wave interactions, contrary to the inverse cascade paradigm of idealized two-dimensional turbulence. Such a plasma regime is attractive for fusion reactors, as it avoids large edge-localized modes (ELMs) that damage first-wall components and maintains high confinement quality even in the presence of high-Z impurities.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合多通道集体汤姆孙散射与径向局域多普勒背散射，在托卡马克热等离子体芯部获得与芯-边耦合相关的前向跨尺度能量转移证据：边缘准相干模进入芯部并与宽带湍流共振耦合，产生次级不稳定性及从离子尺度向电子尺度的净能量转移。
AI.motivation: 磁约束等离子体湍流具有准二维特征，可同时存在逆向和正向能量转移，但热等离子体芯部跨尺度能量转移的实验证据仍然稀少。理解该过程很重要，因为其支配湍流输运并直接影响聚变等离子体的约束质量。
AI.method: 将多通道集体汤姆孙散射（CTS）与径向局域化的多普勒背散射（DBS）结合，用于分辨芯部跨尺度涨落动力学。摘要未提供具体装置、波数范围及定量分析参数。
AI.result: 测量显示，来源于边缘的准相干模（QCM）也存在于芯部，并与宽带湍流发生共振耦合，产生显著的前向能量转移和特征性次级不稳定性。综合测量表明，准二维托卡马克湍流可通过跨尺度波-波相互作用支持从离子尺度到电子尺度的净能量转移，这与理想二维湍流的逆向级联图像相反；该等离子体区还可避免损伤第一壁部件的大型边缘局域模（ELM），并在高Z杂质存在时保持高约束质量。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论是：实验证据与芯-边耦合导致的前向跨尺度能量转移一致，准二维托卡马克湍流并非只能遵循理想二维湍流的逆向级联；这种兼具高约束且避免大ELM的等离子体区对聚变堆有吸引力。摘要未给出定量能量转移率或输运系数。

title: CARS: a centerline-anchored attention surrogate for coronary blood flow on skeleton-generated lumen geometries
summary: When the parameter of a PDE surrogate is the flow domain itself, the key/value set of an attention model must encode that domain. We present CARS (Coronary Artery Rapid Surrogate), a learned surrogate for the finite-volume solution map of the steady incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on coronary lumens built from image-derived centerlines. CARS maps a centerline with per-point lumen radius and a scalar inlet flow rate to pressure and velocity at arbitrary query points. The attention focal set is the case's own centerline, so geometry fusion costs $O(N n_f)$ rather than $O(N^2)$ in the number of evaluation points. Trained per territory on $2{,}700$ OpenFOAM solutions with synthetic focal lesions, CARS reaches relative $\ell_2$ errors of $0.120/0.149$ (pressure/velocity) on left-coronary and $0.063/0.119$ on right-coronary test sets, in $87$~ms per case against a solver wall-clock of $572$-$1{,}063$~s. It outperforms four parameter-matched neural operators, and accuracy saturates eightfold below the operating focal count. Fractional flow reserve derived from the predicted pressure matches the CFD label at Pearson $r = 0.941/0.993$ and reproduces the $\mathrm{FFR}\le 0.8$ decision in $97.7\%/96.3\%$ of held-out cases. The predicted velocity does not satisfy continuity closely enough for derived quantities, and the weights are territory-specific.

AI.tldr: CARS 是一种以冠脉中心线为注意力键/值集合的几何感知神经代理模型，可快速预测稳态不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 有限体积解的压力与速度，并在压力及 FFR 预测上达到较高精度。
AI.motivation: 当 PDE 代理模型的参数是流场域本身时，注意力模型的 key/value 集合必须编码该域；论文旨在为基于影像中心线构建的冠脉管腔提供快速代理，替代昂贵的有限体积 CFD 求解。
AI.method: CARS 将带逐点管腔半径的中心线和标量入口流量映射到任意查询点的压力与速度；注意力焦点集合为该病例自身中心线，使几何融合复杂度为 O(N n_f) 而非评估点数的 O(N^2)。模型按血管区域分别训练，使用 2,700 个含合成局灶病变的 OpenFOAM 解。
AI.result: 测试集相对 ℓ2 误差为左冠压力/速度 0.120/0.149、右冠 0.063/0.119；每例 87 ms，而求解器墙钟时间为 572–1,063 s。CARS 优于四个参数匹配的神经算子，且精度在运行焦点数八分之一处即饱和。由预测压力导出的 FFR 与 CFD 标签的 Pearson r 为 0.941/0.993，并在 97.7%/96.3% 的留出病例中复现 FFR≤0.8 决策。
AI.conclusion: CARS 在冠脉压力与 FFR 快速预测方面表现良好，但预测速度的连续性不足，不能可靠用于派生量；权重具有血管区域特异性。其他泛化性或临床验证细节未在摘要中提供。

title: Efficient Modeling of 3D-Printed Freeform Waveguides with a Transformation Optics-Based Beam Propagation Method
comment: Accepted for publication in Optics Express
summary: An efficient numerical method is introduced for simulating wave propagation in 3D-printed freeform waveguides, referred to as photonic wire bonds (PWBs). This approach integrates transformation optics (TO) with curvilinear meshing to map the original 3D freeform PWB structure onto a straight waveguide, which possesses anisotropic material characteristics. The resulting waveguide is then analyzed using an anisotropic full-vectorial beam propagation method (BPM). To validate the performance and effectiveness of the proposed TO-BPM algorithm, a comparison is made with the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) technique. Our approach reduces the simulation time by more than two orders of magnitude, depending on the degree of trajectory bending, in combination with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 3.9% in power transmission simulation relative to the FDTD.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将变换光学与曲线网格相结合，把三维打印自由曲面光子线键映射为具有各向异性材料的直波导，并用各向异性全矢量束传播法仿真；与FDTD相比，仿真时间缩短两个数量级以上，功率传输的平均绝对百分比误差为3.9%。
AI.motivation: 针对三维打印自由曲面波导（光子线键）波传播仿真，需要一种高效数值方法；摘要未进一步说明具体应用背景或传统方法瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用变换光学（TO）与曲线网格，将原始三维自由曲面光子线键结构映射为具有各向异性材料特性的直波导，再使用各向异性全矢量束传播法（BPM）进行分析，形成TO-BPM算法。
AI.result: 与有限差分时域（FDTD）方法对比验证：所提方法根据轨迹弯曲程度可将仿真时间缩短两个数量级以上，功率传输仿真的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为3.9%。
AI.conclusion: TO-BPM在保持与FDTD相比较低功率传输误差的同时显著提高仿真效率，验证了其用于三维打印自由曲面光子线键波传播仿真的性能与有效性。

title: Robust PCA Study of TEM Images of Gold Nanospheres: Stable and Dynamic Closed Knot-Like Phase-Space Loops
summary: In this study, we apply Robust PCA to transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images of gold nanoparticles (GNPs) to decompose their geometrical, topological, and dynamical organization into static and dynamic knot-like phase-space loops. Dynamic loops show higher crossing numbers and longer rope lengths, while static loops show higher mean curvature. Although most Alexander determinants were D(t)=1 with isolated values of D(t)=3 at smaller nanoparticle diameters, implying that geometrical complexity does not require topological complexity. The different writhe signs indicate opposite handedness and distinct phase-space geometries in static and dynamic cases. For both static and dynamic knot-like loops, the graphs show an inverse relationship between mean curvature and mean torsion. Flatter trajectories occur at high curvature, and more torsional twisting occurs at low curvature. The small changes in Moffatt-Ricca helicities (~10^-14<<0) are due to circulation-dependent scaling, yet Moffatt-Ricca helicities still follow the same self-linking trend in both static and dynamic configurations. As nanoparticle diameter increases, the dynamic knot-like loops show stronger Kelvin-like spectral localization and smaller minimum self-approach distances, indicating more concentrated spatial modes and tighter geometric folding. At the same time, the decreasing CTEI suggests reduced global phase-space organization. These contrasting trends indicate that the geometrical organization tends to be less global and coherent, and more localized and mode-specific. These results show that the PCA-reconstructed phase space could serve as a mathematical analog to Kelvin's aether, because all disturbances exhibit similar topological configurations with varying degrees of geometric difference.

AI.tldr: 该研究用Robust PCA分析金纳米颗粒TEM图像，将静态与动态的结状相空间环分解，并比较其几何、拓扑与动力学特征。
AI.motivation: 作者希望把金纳米颗粒的几何、拓扑和动力学组织分解为静态与动态的结状相空间环，并检验PCA重构相空间能否作为Kelvin“以太”的数学类比。
AI.method: 对金纳米颗粒的透射电子显微镜图像应用Robust PCA，重构相空间并分析静态与动态结状环；比较交叉数、绳长、平均曲率、Alexander行列式、writhe符号、平均曲率与平均挠率关系、Moffatt-Ricca螺旋度、Kelvin样谱局域化、最小自接近距离及CTEI，并考察纳米颗粒直径变化的影响。
AI.result: 动态环比静态环具有更高交叉数和更长绳长，静态环平均曲率更高；多数Alexander行列式为D(t)=1，仅在较小纳米颗粒直径处出现孤立的D(t)=3，说明几何复杂性不必然要求拓扑复杂性；writhe符号不同表明静态与动态情形具有相反手性和不同相空间几何；静态与动态结状环中平均曲率与平均挠率均呈反比，高曲率对应更平坦轨迹，低曲率对应更强扭转；Moffatt-Ricca螺旋度变化很小（约10^-14且远小于0），归因于依赖环量的缩放，但静态与动态构型仍遵循相同自链接趋势；随纳米颗粒直径增大，动态结状环呈现更强的Kelvin样谱局域化和更小的最小自接近距离，表明空间模式更集中、几何折叠更紧，同时CTEI下降提示全局相空间组织减弱；这些对比趋势表明几何组织趋于较少全局性与相干性、更多局域性与模式特异性。
AI.conclusion: Robust PCA重构的相空间可作为Kelvin“以太”的数学类比，因为所有扰动表现出相似的拓扑构型，仅几何差异程度不同。

title: Finite time implosions of the multidimensional compressible Euler equations with a finite far-field cutoff
summary: We study the problem of finite time singularities in the isentropic compressible Euler equations in multiple dimensions with radial symmetry. Our initial data consists of the radially symmetric Kidder self-similar implosion with a continuous constant density cutoff. Motivated by our recent work on the one-dimensional problem, we present high-resolution radially symmetric adaptive mesh refinement simulations that when combined with asymptotic similarity solution analysis present a full picture of the ensuing dynamics of the implosion. From the cutoff point in the initial data, an expanding wave emerges. The endpoints of the wave follow the "imploding" and "exploding" characteristic speeds associated with the system of hyperbolic conservation laws. This wave has much more complex structure than the exact non-centered rarefaction wave that emerges in the one-dimensional problem. As in the one-dimensional case, the inner Kidder solution is swallowed up by the expanding wave as time approaches the singularity time. However, unlike the one-dimensional case, a blowup occurs along the point where the `imploding' side of the expanding wave attaches to the Kidder solution. This composite blowup has an asymptotic self-similar form that has an interpretation in terms of the Gurderley-type self-similarity structure. The numerical method for the PDE necessitates a Lagrangian scheme to avoid the numerical diffusion inherent in Eulerian methods. We use a leapfrog method coupled to recursive refinement of the mesh near the blowup, which allows for very high resolution simulations, resolving many orders of magnitude of the self-similar blowup. Consistent with prior rigorous results for these equations, the blowup does not involve mass concentration and exhibits a critical $L^p$ space for the concentration of the density, depending on the dimension of space.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多维径向对称等熵可压缩Euler方程在带连续常密度截断的Kidder自相似内爆初值下的有限时间奇异性；通过高分辨率径向自适应网格模拟结合相似解渐近分析，刻画膨胀波、Kidder解被吞没以及沿波与Kidder解连接点形成的复合自相似爆破。
AI.motivation: 受作者近期一维问题工作的启发，旨在将分析推广到多维径向对称情形，给出内爆后续动力学的完整图像，并理解膨胀波与有限时间爆破的形成机制。
AI.method: 初值采用径向对称Kidder自相似内爆并加连续常密度截断；数值上采用径向对称自适应网格加密的高分辨率模拟，使用Lagrangian格式（leapfrog方法耦合爆破解附近递归网格加密）以避免Eulerian方法的数值扩散，并结合渐近相似解分析。摘要未给出具体空间维数、网格参数及误差或收敛率。
AI.result: 从初值截断点产生膨胀波，其两端分别遵循双曲守恒律系统的“内爆”和“外爆”特征速度；该波结构比一维精确非中心稀疏波更复杂。随时间趋于奇点时间，内部Kidder解被膨胀波吞没；与一维不同，爆破发生在膨胀波“内爆”侧附着于Kidder解的位置，形成具有Guderley型自相似结构的复合爆破。爆破不涉及质量集中，密度集中存在依赖于空间维数的临界L^p空间，与既有严格结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 多维径向对称等熵可压缩Euler方程中，带截断的Kidder内爆会演化出复杂膨胀波并最终形成沿波与Kidder解连接点的复合自相似爆破；该工作给出了这一奇异性的完整动力学图像，并与关于无质量集中和临界L^p的先前严格结果相符。摘要未提供具体维数、临界指数数值及严格证明细节。

title: Intrinsic Angular Momentum Contribution to the Sagnac Response of a Rotating Helical Optical Fiber
summary: We investigate rotation-induced phase accumulation of structured light in a mechanically rotating uniform helical optical fiber using a four-component optical Dirac-like equation. In the paraxial and weak-geometry regime, the intrinsic dynamics contain a torsion-induced geometric coupling and a mechanical rotation--angular-momentum coupling. We show that, in a common-path mirror-reflection geometry, both the torsion-induced geometric phase and the conventional area-dependent Sagnac contribution cancel over a complete round trip, whereas the intrinsic rotation--angular-momentum phase survives. The surviving phase depends on the intrinsic total angular momentum of the structured optical mode and provides a common-path interferometric route for probing intrinsic angular momentum effects in rotational sensing.

AI.tldr: 论文利用四分量光学狄拉克型方程，研究结构化光在机械旋转的均匀螺旋光纤中由旋转诱导的相位积累，并分析往返几何中各类相位的抵消与保留情况。
AI.motivation: 探究结构化光在机械旋转的均匀螺旋光纤中的旋转诱导相位积累，特别是内在动力学中的扭转诱导几何耦合与机械旋转—角动量耦合，并寻找共路干涉探测内在角动量效应的途径。
AI.method: 采用四分量光学狄拉克型方程，在近轴和弱几何条件下分析均匀螺旋光纤中的光场动力学；并在共路镜面反射几何中考察完整往返过程里扭转诱导几何相位、面积依赖的Sagnac贡献以及旋转—角动量相位的演化。
AI.result: 在共路镜面反射几何中，扭转诱导的几何相位和常规的面积依赖Sagnac贡献在完整往返后均抵消，而内在的旋转—角动量相位保留下来；该保留相位依赖于结构化光学模式的内在总角动量。
AI.conclusion: 保留下来的旋转—角动量相位为旋转传感中探测内在角动量效应提供了一条共路干涉测量途径。

title: A novel mechanism for spontaneous ExB shear layer formation in scrape-off-layer plasmas
summary: We present a novel mechanism for spontaneous shear-flow generation in the scrape-off layer (SOL) of magnetically confined plasmas, arising at abrupt changes in the sheath connection length $L_\parallel$. Such transitions occur naturally in the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator. Applying a critical balance treatment for interchange turbulence, we find that $L_\parallel$ sets the equilibrium pressure gradient and hence the radial electric field away from the transition, producing an $E\times B$ shear around the transition comparable to the turbulence growth rate. High-fidelity simulations are shown to be consistent with the theoretical prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种在磁约束等离子体刮削层中由鞘连接长度 L∥ 的突变自发产生剪切流的机制，并以临界平衡处理和高质量模拟验证其理论预测。
AI.motivation: 研究刮削层中自发剪切流生成的新机制，特别是鞘连接长度 L∥ 突变处的情形；该突变在 Wendelstein 7-X 仿星器中自然出现。摘要未提供更具体的应用背景或工程动机。
AI.method: 针对交换湍流采用临界平衡处理，分析 L∥ 对平衡压力梯度和径向电场的影响，并用高保真模拟与理论预测进行对比。
AI.result: 分析表明，L∥ 决定突变区域之外的平衡压力梯度和径向电场，从而在突变附近产生与湍流增长率相当的 E×B 剪切；高保真模拟结果与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: L∥ 突变可作为一种自发剪切流生成机制，理论预测与高保真模拟相符，并可能与 Wendelstein 7-X 中自然出现的此类转变相关。

title: Shear-induced mechanical yielding controls cluster morphology and dynamics in aggregating non-Brownian suspensions
summary: In sheared aggregating suspensions, flow drives both the formation and breakage of particle clusters, whose dynamic evolution influences transport and rheological properties. Understanding these mechanisms remains challenging due to the complex interplay between interparticle forces, hydrodynamic interactions, and shear flow. Using parallelized Accelerated Stokesian Dynamics (PASD) simulations, we investigate cluster microstructure and rotational dynamics, and how their coupling produces suspension stress in sheared, attractive non-Brownian suspensions. When interparticle attraction dominates over separating shear forces, clusters grow until mechanical loading balances maximum interparticle bond strength. We examine how the cluster stresslet depends on cluster size, with both quantities normalized by their mechanical yielding scales. Scaled cluster stresslets collapse onto a master curve exhibiting three distinct regimes: cubic, quadratic, and linear with respect to the scaled radius of gyration $R_g$. In the cubic regime, small, compact clusters behave as rigid bodies, whose hydrodynamic stresslet scales with cluster volume $R_g^3$. As clusters grow into the quadratic regime, low-aspect-ratio clusters preferentially yield under flow, driving a proportional increase in average aspect ratio with size. High-aspect-ratio clusters follow Jeffery rotational dynamics within the flow-gradient plane, spending longer durations aligned with the flow and thereby reducing their time-averaged hydrodynamic stresslet to scale as $R_g^2$. In the linear regime, clusters approach the maximum size sustainable by the interparticle bonds. The internal tension is bounded by the maximum bond strength, limiting the stresslet to an $R_g$ dependence. These findings establish a mechanistic framework connecting microscale cluster morphology and dynamics to macroscale rheology.

AI.tldr: 该文利用并行加速Stokesian动力学（PASD）模拟研究剪切作用下吸引性非布朗悬浮液中团簇的微结构与旋转动力学，并揭示其耦合如何产生悬浮液应力；归一化团簇应力张量随回转半径呈立方、二次和线性三种标度 regime，并塌缩到一条主曲线。
AI.motivation: 剪切聚集悬浮液中颗粒团簇的形成与破碎动态影响输运和流变性质，但粒子间作用力、流体力学相互作用与剪切流的复杂耦合使相关机制难以理解，因此需要厘清团簇微结构、旋转动力学及其与宏观应力之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用并行加速Stokesian动力学（PASD）模拟剪切下的吸引性非布朗悬浮液，分析团簇微结构、尺寸、回转半径、长径比和旋转动力学；将团簇应力张量与团簇尺寸分别用机械屈服尺度归一化，并考察其标度关系。
AI.result: 当粒子间吸引力主导分离性剪切力时，团簇持续生长直至机械载荷与最大粒子间键强平衡。归一化团簇应力张量塌缩为一条主曲线，并呈现三种 regime：立方 regime 中小而紧凑的团簇近似刚体，流体动力应力张量随 R_g^3 标度；二次 regime 中低长径比团簇优先屈服，平均长径比随尺寸增加，高长径比团簇在流梯度平面内遵循 Jeffery 旋转动力学、较长时间沿流对齐，使时间平均流体动力应力张量随 R_g^2 标度；线性 regime 中团簇接近粒子间键可维持的最大尺寸，内部张力受最大键强限制，应力张量随 R_g 标度。摘要未提供具体数值参数或定量实验验证结果。

title: Laser-design methodology for extending an available wavelength range of dual-wavelength injection-seeded laser
comment: 20 pages including 8 figures and 1 supplementary material
summary: This paper describes a method for expanding the applicable wavelength range of dual-wavelength oscillation injection-locked lasers. Special focus is placed on the laser design that enables simultaneous oscillations at both the gain center and gain tail, requiring the most stringent requirements. We show that a sufficient performance can be achieved by introducing a wavelength-dependence property onto the output coupling mirror, without giving any losses in the laser resonator. We also show how we can determine such wavelength-dependent property on the basis of experimental measurements. Using the designed output-coupler, in practices, we demonstrate simultaneous oscillations with an equal output power, across a variety of wavelength combinations of near the gain center and around the gain tail in which the wavelength separation amounts 60 nm at the most.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过给输出耦合镜引入波长依赖特性，在不增加谐振腔损耗的情况下扩展双波长振荡注入锁定激光器的适用波长范围，并实验实现增益中心附近与增益尾部附近、最大间隔60 nm的等功率双波长同时振荡。

AI.method: 在输出耦合镜上引入波长依赖特性，同时避免给激光谐振腔带来额外损耗；并给出基于实验测量确定该波长依赖特性的方法，据此设计输出耦合器。

AI.conclusion: 通过在输出耦合镜引入波长依赖特性，可在不增加谐振腔损耗的前提下获得足够性能，并实现宽间隔、等功率的双波长同时振荡；摘要未提供具体波长范围、功率数值及锁定性能的定量细节。

title: Evolution of Jeans instability in nonthermal magnetized complex plasmas
summary: The classical Jeans instability framework provides a conceptual foundation for understanding self-gravitational collapse and subsequent star formation in interstellar environments. However, cosmic plasmas are inherently magnetized and frequently collisionless, exhibiting significant departures from local thermodynamic equilibrium. While linear theories predict initial instability thresholds, they fail to track the long-term nonlinear runaway dynamics. We present a fluid simulation investigating the nonlinear evolution of the Jeans instability in a magnetized tricomponent complex (dusty) plasma. The constituent nonthermal electrons and ions are governed by the $κ$-distribution law, while the heavier dust grains are treated in a fluid framework, coupled with a uniform ambient magnetic field. The numerical architecture utilizes a fourth-order finite difference method (FDM) for spatial gradients and a second-order leap-frog time-integration scheme. We systematically investigate the complex interplay among the self-gravitational attraction, nonthermal electrostatic screening, and magnetic pressure across a wide range of magnetic field strengths and degrees of nonthermality. It is found that enhanced nonthermality accelerates structural localization, while the magnetic field introduces a critical pressure barrier that suppresses the instability. In highly magnetized environments, thermal and nonthermal systems exhibit identical growth rate characteristics, indicating that magnetic pressure dominates the nonthermal thermostatistics in the strong magnetic regime. This study develops a comprehensive and numerically robust framework to understand early-stage star formation and evolution processes in nonthermal astrophysical media.

AI.tldr: 本文用流体数值模拟研究磁化三组分复杂（尘埃）等离子体中Jeans不稳定性的非线性演化，考察非热性、磁场、自引力与静电屏蔽的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 经典Jeans不稳定性框架可用于理解自引力坍缩与恒星形成，但宇宙等离子体通常磁化、无碰撞且偏离局部热力学平衡；线性理论只能给出初始不稳定阈值，无法追踪长期非线性失控动力学，因此需要研究磁化非热尘埃等离子体中的非线性演化。
AI.method: 构建三组分复杂尘埃等离子体流体模型：非热电子和离子服从κ分布，较重尘埃颗粒采用流体描述，并耦合均匀背景磁场；数值上采用四阶有限差分法计算空间梯度、二阶蛙跳格式进行时间积分，系统改变磁场强度与非热程度，分析自引力、非热静电屏蔽和磁压的相互作用。
AI.result: 非热性增强会加速结构局域化；磁场引入临界压力屏障并抑制不稳定性；在强磁化环境中，热系统与非热系统呈现相同的增长率特征，表明强磁场区磁压主导非热恒温统计效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个较全面且数值稳健的框架，用于理解非热天体物理介质中早期恒星形成与演化过程；摘要未提供具体定量参数、模拟尺度或观测验证细节。

title: All-photonic millimeter-wave and terahertz signal core at room and cryogenic temperatures
summary: Millimeter-wave and terahertz technologies offer new opportunities for high-capacity communications, sensing, and quantum systems, but electronic signal chains above 100 GHz are limited by weak sources, noisy receivers, and lossy interconnects. Photonic approaches mitigate these constraints by enabling chip-scale high-frequency components, yet existing implementations generally retain lossy off-chip electrical or free-space links, hindering dense and compact integration for cryogenic or space-constrained settings. Here, we show a monolithic lithium tantalate photonic chip, termed a signal core, which generates, modulates, routes, and detects continuous-wave signals at discrete frequencies between 100 GHz and 2.5 THz. The architecture integrates high-frequency functional modules on chip and uses exclusively fiber-based optical interfaces. Bidirectional coherent electro-optic conversion enables signal generation, detection, and nanosecond-scale amplitude and phase modulation, while micro-coplanar striplines interconnect the modules into an end-to-end signal chain on a single chip. Our modules achieve single-photon electro-optic coupling rates of g_0/2π=10 kHz and peak drive-power-normalized photon-flux conversion efficiencies of 1.0%/mW for generation and 0.5%/mW for detection. It also operates at 4 K in a dilution refrigerator through the same fiber-only optical links. Together, these capabilities establish an all-photonic platform for millimeter-wave-to-terahertz systems and offer a broadly applicable architecture for applications constrained by electrical-interconnect loss, heat load, and footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文报道一种单片钽酸锂光子芯片（signal core），可在100 GHz至2.5 THz的离散频率上产生、调制、路由并探测连续波信号；芯片集成高频功能模块并仅采用光纤光学接口，还通过相同光纤链路在4 K稀释制冷机中工作，从而构建全光子毫米波至太赫兹平台。
AI.motivation: 毫米波与太赫兹技术在高速通信、传感和量子系统方面具有潜力，但100 GHz以上电子信号链受限于弱源、噪声接收机和有损互连。现有光子方案虽可缓解这些问题，却通常仍依赖有损的片外电链路或自由空间链路，不利于低温或空间受限场景中的密集、紧凑集成。

AI.result: 该芯片在100 GHz至2.5 THz的离散频率上实现连续波信号的产生、调制、路由和探测，具备双向相干电光转换、纳秒级幅度与相位调制及单芯片端到端信号链，并达到上述耦合率和转换效率指标；同时演示了4 K低温环境下的纯光纤接口运行。

title: Plasma transport by carrier electrons: classical coefficients across ionization and magnetization
summary: The classical transport of magnetic field and electron energy in a plasma requires the use of coefficients that depend on plasma ionization $Z$ and magnetization $χ$. This paper explains these scalings through studying the electron velocities responsible for each transport process. Both electron-electron collisions and magnetization affect higher velocity electron populations preferentially, lowering the carrier velocities; transport carried by a high energy electron population is therefore more suppressed by both electron-electron collisions and magnetization than transport carried by lower velocities. Carrier Hall parameters $ψ=χf(Z)$ are defined for each coefficient such that magnetization can be described independent of ionization. An analytic idealized coefficient with a single rigid carrier velocity reproduces many of the characteristics of the coefficients, in particular thermal conductivity, but overestimates plasma magnetization due to magnetization itself lowering the carrier velocity. A single moving carrier model improves agreement, but cannot describe the smoothness of the Righi-Leduc coefficient, which originates from being an average over a range of carrier velocities. This is the first paper in a 3-part series; the subsequent papers will extend the carrier picture to non-local heat-flux (paper 2) and non-local magnetic field evolution (paper 3).

AI.tldr: 论文从负责各输运过程的电子速度出发，解释等离子体磁场合电子能量经典输运系数随电离度 Z 和磁化率 χ 的标度关系；提出载流子霍尔参数 ψ=χf(Z)，并用单刚性载流子与单移动载流子模型检验其适用性。
AI.motivation: 经典等离子体输运需要依赖电离度 Z 和磁化率 χ 的输运系数，本文旨在通过分析各输运过程中起主导作用的电子速度，解释这些系数随 Z 和 χ 的标度关系。
AI.method: 从电子速度角度建立载流子图像；考虑电子-电子碰撞和磁化对高速度电子群体的优先影响；为各输运系数定义载流子霍尔参数 ψ=χf(Z)，使磁化描述可与电离度分离；采用单一刚性载流子速度的解析理想化系数，并进一步采用单移动载流子模型进行比较。
AI.result: 单一刚性载流子速度的理想化系数可再现输运系数的许多特征，尤其是热导率，但因磁化本身会降低载流子速度而高估等离子体磁化；单移动载流子模型改善一致性，但无法描述 Righi-Leduc 系数的平滑性，该平滑性源于对一段载流子速度范围的平均。
AI.conclusion: 电子载流子速度图像能够解释输运系数随电离度和磁化的标度特征，并揭示不同模型的适用性与局限；本文是三篇系列论文的第一篇，后续论文将把载流子图像扩展到非局域热流和非局域磁场演化。摘要未提供定量验证或具体参数范围。

title: Light pulse propagation through a dielectric slab. II. Two roads to the same field: numerical cross-validation of local (FDTD-ADE) and non-local (retarded integral-equation) solutions
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Paper II of a series; companion paper to arXiv:2610.29336 (Paper I)
summary: Paper I of this series (arXiv:2610.29336) solves, via the retarded Green's functions, the local differential equations governing light propagation in a plane-parallel dielectric slab, obtaining a pair of retarded integral equations that represent, at the continuum level, the microscopic multiple-scattering picture underlying the local formulation. The two formulations are thus proven to be analytically equivalent. The local system of differential equations is then solved numerically with a finite-difference time-domain scheme (FDTD-ADE). This report closes the loop by solving the retarded integral equations directly, without passing through the local formulation, and comparing the result with the FDTD-ADE solution under the same physical and material conditions. The two independently implemented, structurally different numerical schemes agree within 0.02-1.3% for the reported reflected and transmitted energy fractions; the absorbed fraction, computed independently in both schemes from the Lorentz damping term rather than merely inferred from 1-R-T, agrees closely between the two methods, to the precision reported. Both solutions are also compared with an exact reference, the Airy formula weighted over the pulse spectrum: the direct solution reproduces it to within 0.3%, and its Richardson extrapolation to all digits shown. The agreement persists for a few-cycle pulse and for a sub-wavelength slab, where naive fixed-point iteration of the integral equations is not a practical convergent strategy. A complementary set of movie-style, nine-frame visualizations is also presented, illustrating the same equivalence directly in the field rather than only in integrated observables. To the author's knowledge, a direct numerical cross-validation of these two formulations in this genuinely time-dependent regime has not previously been reported.

AI.tldr: 本文将第一篇文章得到的延迟积分方程直接数值求解，不经过局部微分方程表述，并与FDTD-ADE结果、按脉冲谱加权的Airy精确参考及Richardson外推进行交叉验证；反射和透射能量分数在0.02%–1.3%内一致，直接解与Airy参考在0.3%内一致，且在少周期脉冲与亚波长介质板情形仍成立。
AI.motivation: 第一篇文章已证明局部微分方程表述与延迟积分方程表述解析等价，并用FDTD-ADE求解局部系统；本文旨在闭合验证链条，直接求解延迟积分方程，从数值上独立检验两种结构不同的表述在真实时变情形下的一致性。
AI.method: 直接求解由延迟格林函数得到的延迟积分方程，而不经过局部表述；在相同物理与材料条件下与FDTD-ADE结果比较反射、透射能量分数，并由洛伦兹阻尼项独立计算吸收分数而非仅用1-R-T推断；同时与按脉冲谱加权的Airy公式精确参考及Richardson外推比较，并给出九帧电影式场可视化。摘要未提供具体材料参数、几何参数和脉冲参数。
AI.result: 两种独立实现、结构不同的数值方案给出的反射和透射能量分数在0.02%–1.3%内一致；由洛伦兹阻尼项独立计算的吸收分数在摘要所述精度内吻合。直接解与加权Airy参考在0.3%内一致，其Richardson外推与参考在所示全部位数上一致。该一致性在少周期脉冲和亚波长厚度介质板情形仍保持，而这些情形下对积分方程做朴素定点迭代不是实用的收敛策略。
AI.conclusion: 直接求解延迟积分方程可独立复现FDTD-ADE结果并逼近精确参考，从数值上支持两种表述的解析等价性，并将等价性从积分观测量扩展到场层面的可视化展示；作者称此前尚未报道该真实时变区间内两种表述的直接数值交叉验证。

title: First Results of Calculation of the Dayside Magnetopause Reconnection Rate with TRACERS
comment: Under revision for Journal of Geophysical Research: Space Physics
summary: Quantifying the rate of reconnection remains a key challenge in the study of geomagnetic storms. In this study, we present the first results from the new Tandem Reconnection and Cusp Electrodynamics Reconnaissance Satellites (TRACERS) mission to calculate the reconnection rate from dispersed ion populations measured in the cusp, using previously developed methodology. We study ion dispersion events in two storms. During the first storm, which occurred on September 30, 2025, 21 dispersion events were identified in TRACERS 2 ion data as a combined result of geospace dynamics and the spacecraft cusp encounters. Throughout this time when ion dispersion was detected by TRACERS , the reconnection rate is calculated and is shown to track reasonably well with another measure of geomagnetic activity, the Cross Polar Cap Potential (CPCP) as obtained by the Super Dual Auroral Radar Network (SuperDARN). The dispersions are correlated with the smoothed CPCP, and a correlation of $r^2=0.62$ was found using the dispersions from the onset and main phase of the storm. The correlation disappears when including dispersions from the recovery period. The distribution of reconnection rates throughout this storm lies generally between 0.1 - 1.5 mV/m, slightly lower than previous reconnection rates calculated with DMSP, but consistent with in-situ observations made with Polar. In this work, we also apply a previously developed automatic identification algorithm for ion-energy cusp dispersion to TRACERS, with the intent that it may serve as a tool for future statistical analysis as the data volume becomes too large to manually review.

AI.tldr: 该文报道 TRACERS 任务首批结果：利用尖点区离散离子群按既有方法计算磁重联率，并在一次地磁暴中与 SuperDARN 的 CPCP 进行对比，同时测试自动识别算法。

AI.method: 采用先前发展的方法，从 TRACERS 卫星在尖点区测得的离散离子群计算重联率；研究两次地磁暴中的离子色散事件。对2025年9月30日第一次暴，在 TRACERS 2 离子数据中识别出21个色散事件，将重联率与 SuperDARN 获得的 CPCP 比较，并把先前开发的离子能量尖点色散自动识别算法应用于 TRACERS 数据。

AI.conclusion: TRACERS 首批结果表明，基于尖点离散离子群可计算重联率，并在暴起始和主相与 CPCP 相关；自动识别算法可作为未来数据量增大时的统计分工具。摘要未给出第二次暴及自动算法性能的详细结论。

title: Reconfigurable Free-Space Optical Interconnects
summary: Free-space optical interconnects can support many low-data-rate channels while avoiding the cost, energy consumption, and packaging constraints of optical waveguide- or fiber-based systems that are widely used today. We propose a free-space optical interconnect system based on reconfigurable micromirror arrays, and show that it scales favorably due to its two-dimensional scaling. We discuss the channel count scaling model, compare our demonstration with theory, and project a channel count above 10,000 to achieve 100 Tbps with slow channels (e.g., <10 Gbps). In a proof-of-concept system with a piston-motion micromirror array, we demonstrate nine channels that are simultaneously optimized. The optimization enables -21.7 dB of average worst-case crosstalk for a channel pitch equal to twice the beam radius, a smaller channel spacing than that required in flat tip-tilt mirrors. The optimization flow is further investigated for different channel spacings, simultaneous illumination, and different numbers of outputs, which generally achieve smaller worst-case crosstalk than the flat tip-tilt mirror case. Overall, the work demonstrates the advantage of piston-motion micromirrors in the proposed optical interconnects.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连系统，利用二维扩展实现通道数增长；建立通道数扩展模型，并用活塞运动微镜阵列完成9通道同时优化的概念验证，在通道间距为光束半径两倍时获得平均最坏串扰-21.7 dB，并展望超过10000通道、以低于10 Gbps的慢通道实现100 Tbps。
AI.motivation: 自由空间光互连可支持大量低数据率通道，同时规避当前广泛使用的光波导或光纤系统在成本、能耗和封装方面的限制；论文希望利用可重构微镜阵列实现可扩展的自由空间光互连。
AI.method: 提出基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连系统；讨论通道数扩展模型，并将演示结果与理论比较；在概念验证系统中采用活塞运动微镜阵列，对9个通道进行同时优化；进一步研究不同通道间距、同时照明和不同输出数量下的优化流程，并与平面tip-tilt微镜方案比较。摘要未提供具体器件尺寸、完整链路数据率实测和功耗等细节。
AI.result: 概念验证实现9个通道同时优化；在通道间距等于两倍光束半径时，平均最坏串扰为-21.7 dB，其通道间距小于平面tip-tilt微镜所需间距；不同通道间距、同时照明和不同输出数量下，优化流程通常获得比平面tip-tilt微镜更小的最坏串扰；模型预测超过10000个通道可以以低于10 Gbps的慢通道达到100 Tbps。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明活塞运动微镜在所提出的自由空间光互连中具有优势，基于可重构微镜阵列的系统具备有利的二维扩展性；摘要未给出完整系统误码率、端到端功耗和成本等结论。

title: Metasurface engineering of transient photothermal responses for vibrational imaging at living interfaces
summary: Chemical transformations at biological interfaces are central to cellular function, yet the weak vibrational signals associated with subtle molecular changes limit their spatially resolved observation. Here, we present metasurface-driven mid-infrared photothermal imaging (MetaMIP), which uses resonantly engineered metasurfaces to amplify molecular temperature modulation while retaining rapid thermal recovery. Visible-light detection converts this response into submicrometre maps of individual nanoparticles and biological cells. In living cells, MetaMIP resolves spatially distinct chemical changes during enzymatic lipid conversion across the cell membrane. These results demonstrate the potential of engineered photothermal interfaces for mapping chemical composition and tracking its evolution during reactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MetaMIP 技术，利用共振工程化超表面增强中红外光热信号，并通过可见光检测实现纳米颗粒与活细胞的亚微米化学成像，解析细胞膜上酶促脂质转化过程中的空间差异化学变化。
AI.motivation: 生物界面上的化学转化对细胞功能至关重要，但细微分子变化对应的振动信号较弱，限制了其空间分辨观测。
AI.method: 提出超表面驱动中红外光热成像（MetaMIP）：用共振工程化超表面放大分子温度调制，同时保持快速热恢复；再用可见光检测将该响应转化为单个纳米颗粒和生物细胞的亚微米图谱。
AI.result: MetaMIP 可在活细胞中分辨细胞膜上酶促脂质转化过程中空间上不同的化学变化，并实现单个纳米颗粒和生物细胞的亚微米成像。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明工程化光热界面有望用于绘制化学成分并追踪反应过程中化学成分的演化。

title: Alignment-Free Optical Combining with Scalar-Message Expectation Propagation Detection for Distributed Multi-Aperture Coherent Reception
summary: We propose an alignment-free distributed multi-aperture optical receiver with a single coherent front end, in which the differential delays between apertures are large. The branch signals are optically combined without inter-branch delay or phase alignment. Large differential delays produce separated tap clusters, forming a sparse ISI channel with long memory. Scalar-message expectation propagation exploits this sparsity to recover the transmitted symbols. Simulations show lower BER than equal-area single-aperture reception and no clear BER degradation over the tested delay spans. As the maximum differential delay increases from 100.5 to 200.5 symbol periods, the channel span nearly doubles, while the factor-graph edge count increases by only about 1.5\%. The trade-off is higher BER than ideal coherent combining schemes in exchange for fewer coherent front ends than digital combining and no inter-branch delay or phase alignment before optical combining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种免对齐的分布式多孔径光接收机：仅用单个相干前端，各孔径分支信号在光学域直接合并，不进行分支间延时或相位对齐；大差分延时形成稀疏、长记忆的ISI信道，并利用标量消息期望传播恢复符号。仿真显示其BER低于等面积单孔径接收，且在测试延时范围内无明显BER退化；最大差分延时从100.5增至200.5符号周期时，信道跨度近翻倍而因子图边数仅增约1.5%。代价是BER高于理想相干合并方案，但相干前端数量少于数字合并且合并前无需延时/相位对齐。
AI.motivation: 动机是采用单个相干前端实现分布式多孔径光接收，并避免光学合并前的分支间延时和相位对齐；相比数字合并可减少相干前端数量。摘要未进一步明确其他应用动机。
AI.method: 设计免对齐分布式多孔径光接收机，各分支信号不经分支间延时或相位对齐而在光学域合并；利用大差分延时产生的分离抽头簇，将信道建模为稀疏、长记忆ISI信道，并采用标量消息期望传播在因子图上恢复发送符号。仿真测试最大差分延时为100.5至200.5符号周期，并与等面积单孔径接收及理想相干合并方案比较。
AI.result: 仿真中BER低于等面积单孔径接收，在所测延时跨度内没有明显BER退化；最大差分延时从100.5增至200.5符号周期时，信道跨度近翻倍，而因子图边数仅增加约1.5%。其BER高于理想相干合并方案，但相干前端数量少于数字合并，且光学合并前无需分支间延时或相位对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该方案能以稀疏ISI信道和期望传播支持单相干前端下的免对齐多孔径接收，以相对理想相干合并更高的BER换取更少相干前端和免延时/相位对齐；摘要未给出超出仿真结果的进一步结论。

title: Efficient third-harmonic generation in high-Q tantalum pentoxide microcavities
summary: Nonlinear harmonic generation in microcavities offers a compelling route toward energy efficient on-chip short-wavelength coherent light sources, enabled by tight optical confinement within compact mode volumes and flexible dispersion engineering. Tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) photonic platforms are particularly promising for realizing such nonlinear processes: their broad transparency window (280-8000 nm) supports broadband operation, their large bandgap suppresses two-photon absorption, and their thick-film deposition capability enables dispersion management--features that can collectively enhance the performance of nonlinear light sources. Here, we demonstrate, to the best of our knowledge, the first efficient third-harmonic generation (THG) in high-Q Ta2O5 microcavities. These microcavities feature smooth surfaces and high loaded Q factors up to 2.67X10^6, thereby facilitating nonlinear interactions. Through dispersion engineering, efficient THG is realized in both suspended microdisks and monolithic microrings under telecom-band continuous-wave laser pumping, as confirmed by optical spectra, visible-light microscopy, and the near-cubic pump-power dependence of the conversion efficiency. This work lays a foundation for chip-scale f-3f self-referencing of frequency combs and next-generation integrated nonlinear photonics.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在高Q值五氧化二钽（Ta2O5）微腔中实现高效三次谐波产生（THG），并在悬空微盘与单片微环中通过色散工程和通信波段连续波泵浦得到验证。
AI.motivation: 微腔中的非线性谐波产生有望实现节能的片上短波长相干光源；Ta2O5平台具有280–8000 nm宽透明窗口、大带隙抑制双光子吸收以及厚膜沉积带来的色散管理能力，适合增强非线性光源性能。
AI.method: 制备表面光滑、负载Q值最高达2.67×10^6的Ta2O5微腔；通过色散工程，在悬空微盘和单片微环中利用通信波段连续波激光泵浦开展THG实验，并结合光谱、可见光显微成像和转换效率随泵浦功率的近三次方依赖进行确认。
AI.result: 实现了据作者所知首个高效Ta2O5微腔THG；微腔负载Q值最高为2.67×10^6，悬空微盘和单片微环中均观察到THG，光学光谱、可见光显微图像及近立方泵浦功率依赖支持该结果；具体转换效率数值、泵浦功率和波长细节未提供。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为片上频率梳的f-3f自参考及下一代集成非线性光子学奠定了基础。

title: Laser with $7\times10^{-18}$ stability
summary: We report a laser with record frequency stability, based on a 21 cm cryogenic silicon cavity. For best short-term stability, the cavity operates at 6 K to minimize Brownian thermal noise and achieves a fractional stability of $7\times10^{-18}$ between 2 to 50 s of averaging time and 2.5 mHz linewidth. For best long-term stability the cavity operates at 16 K, where silicon has a zero-crossing of thermal expansion. Slightly increased thermal noise limits the performance to $9\times10^{-18}$, consistent with the expected temperature scaling, but the long-term performance is improved. The laser then has a linewidth of 2.9 mHz and long-term frequency drift less than 4 μHz s$^{-1}$. The laser is used to enhance the performance of a state-of-the-art Sr lattice clock, operating with Rabi and Ramsey interrogation times beyond 10 s.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一台基于21 cm低温硅腔的激光器，实现了创纪录的频率稳定度：6 K工作时短期稳定度为7×10^-18（2–50 s平均）且线宽2.5 mHz；16 K工作时长期稳定度更优，稳定度9×10^-18、线宽2.9 mHz、长期漂移小于4 μHz s^-1；该激光用于提升Sr光晶格钟性能，支持超过10 s的Rabi和Ramsey interrogation。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单独明确陈述研究动机；其目标可概括为通过低温硅腔降低热噪声并获得创纪录频率稳定度，同时兼顾短期与长期稳定度，并用于增强最先进Sr光晶格钟的性能。
AI.method: 采用21 cm低温硅腔构建激光系统。为获得最佳短期稳定度，腔体工作在6 K以最小化布朗热噪声；为获得最佳长期稳定度，腔体工作在16 K，利用硅热膨胀系数的零交叉点。随后将该激光用于Sr光晶格钟，采用超过10 s的Rabi和Ramsey interrogation时间。
AI.result: 6 K工作时，2–50 s平均时间内分数频率稳定度为7×10^-18，线宽为2.5 mHz。16 K工作时，热噪声略增使稳定度为9×10^-18，与预期温度标度一致，但长期性能改善；线宽为2.9 mHz，长期频率漂移小于4 μHz s^-1。该激光增强了最先进Sr光晶格钟的性能，使其Rabi和Ramsey interrogation时间超过10 s。
AI.conclusion: 通过在不同温度下运行21 cm低温硅腔，可分别优化短期和长期频率稳定度，并获得创纪录稳定度的激光；该激光能够提升Sr光晶格钟性能并支持超过10 s的 interrogation。

title: Black-Hole Ringdown from Photon-Sphere Modes in an Elastic Analogue
summary: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) govern the ringdown of black holes, yet their physical origin and experimental accessibility remain limited. Here we create an elastic analogue of a black hole using a curved metallic shell engineered to emulate a Schwarzschild-like metric, and directly probe its vibrational dynamics in the time domain. Following impulsive excitation, the elastic system exhibits a clear ringdown response, providing a tangible analogue of black-hole ringing. The underlying modes are flexural vibrations localized near the photon sphere. A reduction of the thin-shell elastic equations yields a photon-sphere effective potential and predicts the dependence of the localized-mode frequencies on azimuthal order. Crucially, they persist even when boundary reflections are strongly suppressed, demonstrating that their confinement is governed by a curvature-induced effective potential rather than by cavity boundaries. This platform enables direct access to quasinormal modes through both their temporal decay and spectral signatures, establishing a direct connection between photon-sphere dynamics and ringdown. More broadly, our results identify curvature-induced trapping as a general mechanism for wave localization and dissipation in open systems.

AI.tldr: 该文利用弯曲金属薄壳构建弹性黑洞类比体系，在时域直接观测由光子球附近局域柔性振动主导的环down响应，并证明其局域化源于曲率诱导有效势而非边界反射。
AI.motivation: 准正规模决定黑洞环down，但其物理起源与实验可及性仍受限；作者希望建立可直接探测准正规模的弹性类比平台，并厘清光子球动力学与环down的联系。
AI.method: 制作可模拟Schwarzschild类度规的弯曲金属薄壳弹性类比体系，施加脉冲激励并进行时域振动测量；约化薄壳弹性方程得到光子球有效势，预测局域模频率随角向阶数的依赖，并在强抑制边界反射条件下检验模式是否持续存在。
AI.result: 体系表现出清晰的环down响应，对应光子球附近的局域柔性振动；有效势预测了局域模频率随角向阶数的依赖；这些模式在边界反射被强烈抑制时仍存在，表明其束缚由曲率诱导有效势而非腔体边界决定。摘要未提供具体频率、衰减率或定量参数。
AI.conclusion: 该平台可通过时间衰减与频谱特征直接获取准正规模，建立光子球动力学与环down的直接联系；结果将曲率诱导俘获识别为开放系统中波局域与耗散的一般机制。

title: Foundry-Fabricated Silicon Nitride Grating Arrays with Uniform Power Distribution at Visible Wavelengths
comment: Main: 4 pages, 4 figures; Supplementary: 10 pages, 8 figures
summary: Multiplexed optical biosensors are widely deployed to read out many biological targets in parallel. However, their channel count and integration density are limited by the photonic network that delivers light to individual sensing sites. Existing on-chip networks have been largely developed for phased arrays and image projection, where performance is assessed through an aggregate radiation pattern rather than the local intensity at each output. In this Letter, we demonstrate a novel bus-and-tap network architecture for massively parallel multiplexed optical delivery. The network uses cascaded directional couplers with individually designed interaction lengths, allowing for arbitrary, user-defined illumination patterns not possible with conventional binary tree architectures. We experimentally validated our proposed architecture with 46 visible-wavelength grating emitter channels designed for uniform illumination at 40 $μ$m pitch in a commercial 300-mm silicon nitride foundry process, achieving an emitted-intensity coefficient of variation of 9.3% at 530 nm, and 8.8% under band-integrated illumination from 550 nm to 650 nm. These results provide a route to scalable visible-light delivery for sensing, imaging, neural interfaces, and parallel optical addressing in quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实验验证了一种用于大规模并行多路复用光传输的 bus-and-tap 光网络架构，通过级联且独立设计交互长度的定向耦合器，在硅 nitride 工艺中实现了 46 通道可见光栅发射器的均匀照明。
AI.motivation: 多路复用光学生物传感器需要并行读取大量生物靶标，但其通道数和集成密度受限于向各传感位点分配光的光子网络；现有片上网络主要面向相控阵和图像投影，性能以整体辐射图案而非每个输出端局部强度评估，难以满足局部均匀照明需求。
AI.method: 提出 bus-and-tap 网络架构，采用具有 individually designed interaction lengths 的级联定向耦合器，实现任意、用户定义的照明图案，突破传统二叉树架构的限制；并在商业 300-mm 硅 nitride 代工工艺中制作 46 个可见光波长 grating emitter 通道，按 40 μm 间距进行均匀照明设计。
AI.result: 实验实现 530 nm 处发射强度变异系数 9.3%，在 550 nm 至 650 nm 带内积分照明下变异系数 8.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为传感、成像、神经接口以及量子系统中的并行光学寻址提供了可扩展的可见光传输路径。

title: Rank-One Loss Maximizes the Spectral Response Strength of Passive Full-Order Exceptional Points
summary: We consider finite-dimensional non-Hermitian systems in which all modes coalesce at a single exceptional point. For a rank-one anti-Hermitian contribution, the spectral response strength is computed exactly. For passive systems, we then derive a sharp upper bound at fixed exceptional-point decay rate and show that it is reached only when the decay operator has rank one, corresponding to a single independent dissipative direction. This establishes rank-one loss as the optimal configuration for enhancing the response of a full-order exceptional point. The bound holds for arbitrary order and improves on earlier passive estimates beyond second order. Two third-order trimers illustrate the result: a rank-one-loss system saturates the bound, whereas a passive rank-two-loss realization remains below it. The result turns dissipation into a design resource: concentrating the loss into a single effective dissipative direction maximizes the highest-order spectral response of a passive full-order exceptional-point device.

AI.tldr: 本文研究所有模式在单一例外点合并的有限维非厄米系统，针对被动系统推导固定例外点衰减率下的尖锐谱响应上界，并证明只有秩一损耗算子能达到该上界，从而表明将损耗集中到单一有效耗散方向可最大化全阶例外点器件的最高阶谱响应。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是理解并增强全阶例外点非厄米系统的谱响应，同时厘清被动系统中损耗结构对响应上限的影响；摘要指出已有被动估计在二阶以上仍需改进，并希望把耗散从不利因素转化为设计资源。
AI.method: 对秩一反厄米贡献精确计算谱响应强度；针对被动系统，在固定例外点衰减率条件下推导尖锐上界，并分析上界达到条件；证明该上界仅当衰减算子为秩一、即只有一个独立耗散方向时达到；结果适用于任意阶，并用两个三阶三聚体实例比较秩一损耗与秩二损耗实现。
AI.result: 得到固定例外点衰减率下被动系统的尖锐谱响应上界，且该上界只在衰减算子为秩一时达到；该界适用于任意阶并改进了二阶以上的早期被动估计；三阶三聚体示例中，秩一损耗系统饱和该上界，而被动秩二损耗实现低于该上界。摘要未提供具体数值或实验细节。
AI.conclusion: 秩一损耗是全阶例外点响应增强的最优配置；将损耗集中到单一有效耗散方向，可最大化被动全阶例外点器件的最高阶谱响应，因此耗散可作为设计资源而非仅被视为限制。

title: Entanglement certification of attosecond light fields with photoelectron interferometry
summary: The emergence of entangled quantum optical states in high-harmonic generation raises a fundamental problem about its characterization, namely, \textit{how can entanglement of extreme-ultraviolet radiation be certified for attosecond light fields?} Here, we provide experimentally accessible separability tests, particularly showing that attosecond photoelectron interferometry provides a direct solution to this problem. This is achieved by a quantum optical treatment of mapping photoelectron interferometry to the measurement of optical correlation functions. This yields a negative-partial-transpose witness for infrared-XUV entanglement and a sufficient witness of genuine multipartite entanglement without auxiliary optical measurements. We evaluate both witnesses on explicit optical states and identify how the protocol can be extended to XUV-XUV entanglement certification. Hence, we establish attosecond photoelectron interferometry as a general framework for entanglement certification across a wide range of optical frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于阿秒光电子干涉术的实验可访问可分性检验，用于认证极紫外与红外光场间的纠缠，并给出红外-XUV纠缠的负部分转置见证及无辅助光学测量的真多体纠缠充分见证。
AI.motivation: 高次谐波产生中涌现的纠缠量子光态引发表征难题：如何为阿秒光场认证极紫外辐射的纠缠；因此需要实验上可实现的分离性检验。
AI.method: 对映射光电子干涉术到光学关联函数测量进行量子光学处理，从而构造红外-XUV纠缠的负部分转置见证，以及无需辅助光学测量的真多体纠缠充分见证；并在显式光学态上评估两类见证，同时识别协议扩展至XUV-XUV纠缠认证的方式。
AI.result: 研究表明阿秒光电子干涉术可直接解决上述认证问题；所得见证在显式光学态上得到评估，且协议可扩展用于XUV-XUV纠缠认证；摘要未提供具体实验数据或定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 阿秒光电子干涉术可成为跨广泛光学频率范围的通用纠缠认证框架。

title: ADAPT for Science: A Multi-Agent System for Self-Evolving Scientific Optimization
summary: Scientific discovery often requires identifying a small number of high-performing designs in vast, constrained search spaces. This is difficult when evaluations are costly, feasible solutions are sparse, parameters are strongly coupled, and physical constraints are strict. Recent AI for AI methods can automatically improve algorithms and optimization procedures. However, general purpose approaches are not designed around scientific priors, physical constraints, and limited evaluation budgets. We introduce ADAPT for Science, a multi-agent framework that treats scientific optimization as two coupled decisions: where to search and how to search. ADAPT uses historical designs to identify promising and diverse initial conditions, progressively concentrates computation on favorable search directions, and evolves the optimization procedure from execution feedback. We evaluate ADAPT on the design of gravitational wave detectors using a differentiable physics simulator and eight unseen detector topologies. Under matched scientific evaluation budgets, ADAPT achieves a mean loss of 0.204 +/- 0.101, reducing loss by 54.9% relative to the best classical optimizer and by 62.2% relative to the best general purpose agentic evolution baseline. ADAPT achieves the lowest loss on all unseen topologies among the evaluated baselines. ADAPT provides a step toward scientific optimization systems that continuously learn from prior experience and their own search outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多智能体科学优化框架 ADAPT for Science，将科学优化拆解为“在哪里搜索”和“如何搜索”两个耦合决策，并在引力波探测器设计任务上显著优于经典优化器和通用智能体演化基线。

AI.method: ADAPT for Science 是一个多智能体框架，将科学优化视为“在哪里搜索”和“如何搜索”两个耦合决策：利用历史设计识别有前景且多样的初始条件，逐步将计算集中到有利搜索方向，并基于执行反馈演化优化过程。论文使用可微物理模拟器和八个未见探测器拓扑评估引力波探测器设计。

title: Wavenumber-Aware Deep Learning for Robust Analysis of Raman Spectra
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; Supplementary Information (15 pages) included
summary: Machine-learning models for spectroscopy usually treat a spectrum as a fixed-grid intensity vector, leaving the physical coordinate implicit in the array index. Such models are tied to a single sampling grid, spectral range and resolution, which limits their use when measurement conditions change. Here we represent each spectral point as a pair of intensity and wavenumber and compute Transformer positional encodings from the wavenumber itself. On Raman spectra of three bacterial species and their synthetic mixtures, this representation remained robust to noise, sparser sampling and partial spectral coverage across convolutional, residual and Transformer networks. In controlled comparisons, wavenumber-based encoding outperformed index-based and learned encodings under partial observation and retained its performance on sampling grids never seen during training, where index-based encoding degraded. These findings were reproduced on a public 30-isolate bacterial benchmark. Explicit physical coordinates offer a simple route to robust spectral analysis under variable measurement conditions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用“强度-波数”对表示光谱点，并由波数计算Transformer位置编码，使光谱模型不依赖固定采样网格；在细菌拉曼光谱及公开基准上验证了其在噪声、稀疏采样、部分覆盖和未见采样网格下的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 传统光谱机器学习模型通常把光谱视为固定网格上的强度向量，物理坐标隐含在数组索引中，导致模型与单一采样网格、光谱范围和分辨率绑定，测量条件变化时适用性受限。
AI.method: 将每个光谱点显式表示为强度与波数配对，并基于波数本身计算Transformer位置编码；在三种细菌及其合成混合物的拉曼光谱上，跨卷积网络、残差网络和Transformer网络评估，并比较基于波数、基于索引和可学习编码，测试噪声、稀疏采样、部分光谱覆盖及训练中未见采样网格，同时在公开的30个分离株细菌基准上复现。
AI.result: 该表示在卷积、残差和Transformer网络中均对噪声、更稀疏采样和部分光谱覆盖保持稳健；在部分观测下，基于波数的编码优于基于索引和可学习编码；在训练中未见的采样网格上保持性能，而基于索引的编码性能下降；结果在公开30个分离株细菌基准上得到复现。摘要未提供具体性能指标、数据集规模和网络结构细节。
AI.conclusion: 显式物理坐标是提升光谱分析在可变测量条件下稳健性的简单途径，可支持跨采样网格、光谱范围和分辨率变化的建模。

title: Thouless Pumping of One-Dimensional Dark Solitons and Domain Walls
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, to appear in Progress of Physics
summary: We predict that quantized transport of dark solitons and domain walls can be observed in mutually sliding optical lattices in both focusing and defocusing nonlinear materials. Two different classes of underlying periodic backgrounds are considered here -- unstaggered and staggered -- which are accurately represented, respectively, by the in-phase and out-of-phase trains of Wannier functions. The nonlinear excitations formed on top of these backgrounds -- dark solitons and domain walls -- are sustained by defocusing or focusing Kerr nonlinearities of the optical medium. Despite non-zero asymptotics, dark solitons and domain walls can still undergo quantized topological transport in dynamically changing refractive index landscape when they and background on which they are constructed are dynamically stable. The extended intervals of propagation constants (and, correspondingly, of the background amplitude) and lattice depths, where stable quantized transport occurs, are identified for both dark solitons and domain walls. Outside these intervals, the quantized transport regime is found to be unstable. Our results extend the concept of nonlinear topological transport from bright to dark soliton states.

AI.tldr: 该文预测：在聚焦与散焦非线性材料中的相互滑动光学晶格内，可观测到暗孤子与畴壁的量子化输运；研究比较非交错与交错两类周期背景，并确定稳定量子化输运的参数区间。
AI.motivation: 将非线性拓扑输运的概念从亮孤子态推广到暗孤子态，并预测暗孤子与畴壁在相互滑动光学晶格中的量子化输运。
AI.method: 考虑非交错和交错两类周期背景，分别用同相与反相 Wannier 函数序列描述；暗孤子和畴壁由介质的散焦或聚焦 Kerr 非线性支持。在动态变化的折射率景观中分析这些激发及其背景的动态稳定性，并识别传播常数、背景振幅和晶格深度的稳定区间。摘要未提供具体数值或实验方法细节。
AI.result: 研究表明，尽管暗孤子和畴壁具有非零渐近值，只要其自身及所基于的背景动态稳定，它们仍可在动态变化的折射率景观中发生量子化拓扑输运；文中识别了暗孤子和畴壁实现稳定量子化输运的较宽传播常数、背景振幅和晶格深度区间，而在这些区间之外量子化输运 regime 不稳定。
